name: Tiffany Shedd
subject: What Earth Day means to conservatives
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Shedd for Attorney General
body:
Building on a legacy of innovation and free enterprise Friends, While others celebrated Earth Day as a reason to justify increased government involvement in our private sector, the annual homage to our planet is rooted in a conservative tradition of conservation, stewardship, and innovation. As an Arizonan who has spent decades working in the natural resource sector, I’m constantly battling against the idea that we need more regulations to preserve our environment for future generations. We don’t have to look far to see what over-regulation looks like. Just take California for example — a state abundant in natural resources utterly destroyed by the heavy hand of government. Golden State politicians shout “increase regulations!” but wag their finger at clean coal, nuclear, natural gas, and hydropower while Californians continue to suffer from rolling blackouts. [**DONATE TODAY TO FIGHT AGAINST THE LEFT'S POLICIES**](http://links.sheddforaz.com/u/click?_t=aef90635dd7e4e83bfd7b3a79f893ad5&_m=15d2ff3e5d5d4ef9aa9ed7ec95bde60e&_e=rwmIX4YPd5uVUhNvOBVDDKCTGVUsz37G0rDqCPSMzgOIbe4qmUcVX22IYBzowbx_9cPIZm6c6XEd10djSYFfyDiL4Kiz5lE-M7cNXFgLiU-MQKMocoDv5AhvKWUUUKtv8wjuFqjgGaHuf2vusJ8pUfgUu0bsQwrxbLyfIvREwV0-omxWHhO8z-05EAK2uFifaQM9XPx36JR9D2EREgtMkTBPuDSMpXsBgQ4ilOk5BxAAAqCYsXxgmIB5IggMVqdvEMeTGs8R54tKuH-tiY0nv_nK2MBGRFl7FjqYNGaD6cO_QmiF985vt4v_0P0FATnd) Thankfully, Arizona is the gold standard for our balanced energy portfolio that includes nuclear, hydropower, solar, clean coal, and natural gas. We have led the way in energy innovation, proving that a market-based approach works.
The Grand Canyon State has [reduced](http://links.sheddforaz.com/u/click?_t=aef90635dd7e4e83bfd7b3a79f893ad5&_m=15d2ff3e5d5d4ef9aa9ed7ec95bde60e&_e=rwmIX4YPd5uVUhNvOBVDDGKCmvvOHMq2jKh4trJtaWCVXbJXpd0op65GzX7WNjxdlHoMnu6yYOPxq5WXJSIs2AiVJqkNAS3YHPh7s6VljB2NXmU9P9sjwckj9E-kuO0-9-IhXyUO3kQc3qltaJc8PTJbNuA3SeKY58D9SpYT6zP0IKaSTC2DNHnvAmuBJwq1mxdQy_-OA7DiXHTI5KexjZmUppIR6s9BjSMINh6T5PrQeLS_3CdVBICtWAFNX13pg5RT0JCqxRVSv528iu_HSIKWEfeIyMPx-DdkL5vSKPqjK7RAaf0kbRkSEvG6lVXoTmNAhVmcuFid4B8Sex4m14dOzP9XKxa40xa1vqO54_m1epFJhFUO5dCVXlB_t_JDmIpdhsTJ_Jj-ppb41wOixyu4lLiAoS1l59gON49egno%3D) CO2 emissions (by over 40%!) while developing a robust energy grid able to handle the demanding energy needs without blackouts, even during the hottest summer months. Arizona has made great strides to reduce water consumption and find ways to recycle wastewater and preserve our most precious resource. [**FIGHT FOR ARIZONA’S FUTURE — JOIN THE TEAM**](http://links.sheddforaz.com/u/click?_t=aef90635dd7e4e83bfd7b3a79f893ad5&_m=15d2ff3e5d5d4ef9aa9ed7ec95bde60e&_e=rwmIX4YPd5uVUhNvOBVDDKASbOvtsAWwQiAnBQ6ykLFqedEG_ix3gHQQ4f39a8UAPhOOkBlUKtI0GculN2VIs6YJHIemwCE9geBCtLxaprM6iY8Hi7jb07tgJT30icFpYKB0fRb0w2Ok9v32UnILsL3mASGXuIZPTaLvsrcN_Z_CAf6zMsnMn_W5OCJxniXfLwccmXBAXFogyLbisqN6RMbwg0YjKi5zRv1OdD18jhpnJDZt1yqWB2D6jxw0pwgeI5kHWOLomxnQ8JTvBhoERA%3D%3D) Life in the desert is not possible without these two things — water and energy. As Attorney General, I will ensure that our state continues to lead the way, understanding that economic and environmental success go hand-in-hand. Let’s celebrate Arizona’s environmental success built by hard-working, innovative locals empowered by free market principles. Let’s not California our Arizona. name: Team Tobias
subject: We can’t afford more of the same
body:
Tina Kotek was the most powerful legislator in Oregon for nearly a decade, while our homelessness and affordable housing crisis only grew worse.
---
| | Hi Peter,

The debate last week made it clear that former Speaker Tina Kotek wants to take credit for passing legislation but none of the responsibility for our deepening homelessness crisis.

[**The silence when Tobias asked “how’s it going?” speaks volumes.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44551329/342101441/1188590255?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZTllZTVhYi1mYmM0LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KL0OMji7kkK7sIuOZJ82bzEVx2OZ9-njPXVP61zvwkw=&emci=89a6456b-fbc4-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=7e9ee5ab-fbc4-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=30662126)

Tina Kotek was the most powerful legislator in Oregon for nearly a decade, while our homelessness and affordable housing crisis only grew worse. Now she claims she’s the one who should fix it? We can’t afford more of the same. And don’t take it from us: on her website, Kotek says, on day one she would establish a... “10-year plan” to solve the crisis. **The truth is this is an emergency. And we can’t wait ten months, let alone ten years.**

Tobias made clear in the debate that we need a sense of urgency that tackles the crisis we face immediately. Meanwhile, Kotek was called out by KGW for ducking direct questions about whether she thought Oregon was on the right track.

[**Check out the recap of Friday’s debate here on KGW.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44551331/342101443/1188590255?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZTllZTVhYi1mYmM0LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KL0OMji7kkK7sIuOZJ82bzEVx2OZ9-njPXVP61zvwkw=&emci=89a6456b-fbc4-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=7e9ee5ab-fbc4-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=30662126)

Obfuscations, pivots, deflections. These are all things Oregonians can’t afford in our next Governor. **Tobias is the decisive leader we need to break through the gridlock and take the homelessness crisis head on.** Now. Not ten years from now.

Thanks,
Team Tobias

Friends,
Welcome back to the “Weekly Wyoming Wrap-Up.” The campaign has now traveled more than 18,000 miles! We have many upcoming events, including the Wyoming Republican State Convention on May 5-7 in Sheridan. We hope to see you there.
Please reach out to our team if you would like to host a town hall or meet and greet in your community!
For Wyoming,
Team Hageman
---
**Around Wyoming! **
Harriet attended the Heart to Heart banquet in Laramie on Friday night. What an uplifting and joyous occasion—to discuss the value of life and honor those individuals who have dedicated their lives to the word of God.
We had a great town hall in Laramie this weekend with some very informed citizens in attendance. Town halls are important for Harriet to discuss current events and learn from individual community members as to what is important to them. Harriet is the only candidate who is holding town hall meetings throughout the state. She has committed to continuing to have such town halls after she is elected! She believes that in a Constitutional Republic, accessibility and accountability are key.
---
---

**Views From the Road **
Wyoming has a beautifully diverse landscape. We are fortunate to be able to witness the stunning vistas as we crisscross the state. We have now seen wild horses, bison, elk, moose, pheasants, wild turkeys sand hill cranes, bald eagles, deer, pronghorn antelope, sheep, cows, and A LOT OF SNOW AND WIND. Hopefully spring is just around the corner for good!
Wyoming’s beauty and Harriet’s photography skills make for some lasting memories.

clean_body: | | | | Friends, Welcome back to the “Weekly Wyoming Wrap-Up.” The campaign has now traveled more than 18,000 miles! We have many upcoming events, including the Wyoming Republican State Convention on May 5-7 in Sheridan. We hope to see you there. Please reach out to our team if you would like to host a town hall or meet and greet in your community! For Wyoming, Team Hageman Around Wyoming! Harriet attended the Heart to Heart banquet in Laramie on Friday night. What an uplifting and joyous occasion—to discuss the value of life and honor those individuals who have dedicated their lives to the word of God. We had a great town hall in Laramie this weekend with some very informed citizens in attendance. Town halls are important for Harriet to discuss current events and learn from individual community members as to what is important to them. Harriet is the only candidate who is holding town hall meetings throughout the state. She has committed to continuing to have such town halls after she is elected! She believes that in a Constitutional Republic, accessibility and accountability are key. Views From the Road Wyoming has a beautifully diverse landscape. We are fortunate to be able to witness the stunning vistas as we crisscross the state. We have now seen wild horses, bison, elk, moose, pheasants, wild turkeys sand hill cranes, bald eagles, deer, pronghorn antelope, sheep, cows, and A LOT OF SNOW AND WIND. Hopefully spring is just around the corner for good! Wyoming’s beauty and Harriet’s photography skills make for some lasting memories. Baker City, OR—April 25, 2022—Oregon Republican gubernatorial candidate, Kerry McQuisten, is honored to announce that her candidacy has been officially endorsed by Steve Yates.

Yates is the former White House Deputy National Security Advisor to the Vice President under the George W. Bush administration; former Chairman of the Idaho Republican Party; and former President of Radio Free Asia under the Trump Administration. He has served in various capacities as an international policy advisor.

Says Yates, “With just over a year of the Biden-Harris administration in office, voters across America see more clearly than ever that elections have consequences. From day one, Joe Biden and the Democrats have projected weakness abroad and wokeness at home. The price for their ideologically-driven incompetence hits hardest on American families, workers and the great men and women who keep us safe. Thankfully, grassroots voters across the country have had enough and are poised to push an historic red wave of American revival to victory in November of this year; it is the first down-payment on Making America Great again – again.

“In this effort to set our country back on the path of greatness, we must begin a revival in the states. Arguably no state has paid more dearly for wokeness and incompetence than has Oregon. Having hit an historic low under Kate Brown, now is the time of choosing for Oregon voters.

**“A Republican for governor can win in Oregon this election, America. But Republicans will need to nominate a candidate with executive experience, who proudly represents rural values, and leads with common sense conservatism. That is why I am proud to support Kerry McQuisten for Governor, and urge you to vote for Kerry in the May 17 primary.”**

McQuisten, whose formal education is in the field of international relations, states, “Often during this campaign, events are consumed with topics like combating crime and homelessness. Those topics are critically important to Oregon. However, there is another aspect of the Governor’s position that is often overlooked, and that’s the leadership role it plays in helping other red states preserve America’s pillars of freedom on a national level, which then places us in a position of strength on an international level. We have to have a governor who can successfully operate on that playing field.”

McQuisten has also been enthusiastically endorsed by President Trump’s first lady of election integrity, Dr. Kelli Ward, who serves as Chair of the Arizona Republican Party; former Oregon State Representative Greg Barreto; Utah State Rep. Ken Ivory who founded the American Lands Council; dozens of businesses around the state; and hundreds of individuals and elected officials from all corners of Oregon. She received gubernatorial endorsements from the Eastern Oregon Mining Association, Oregonians for Medical Freedom, and Restore Oregon NOW.

If elected, McQuisten, who is the mayor of Baker City, a seventh generation Oregonian, and a business owner, would become Oregon’s first female Republican governor, and the first governor from eastern Oregon since the 1950s. She would also be Oregon’s first Republican governor in four decades.
Additional information can be found at the candidate’s web site: www.KerryMcQuisten.com.

As bombs began raining down on Ukrainian cities, Donald Trump called into Fox News to blame – you guessed it – Joe Biden and Hillary Clinton.
As Russian tanks began pouring over the Ukrainian border, Fox News host Laura Ingraham had the gall to call Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky “pathetic.”

Real-time reckoning of lies needs real-time litigation. There is such a thing as gross distortions of fact and purveyors of such must pay a debilitating price. **My answer to Fox when I was an admiral in the U.S. Navy? I pulled the plug.**

Friend,
I am writing to ask you [**to split a donation between my campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand's**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44557647/342130745/821871378?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3400-bu-nd-v2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YmMzNmM3ZC02MWM1LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0kdolU0BRDm8nwgtJ6_wRcCSArXdIX4Ec9cTXJ_K5gU=), but first I want to share with you a story that illustrates why I am in this race.
When I was growing up, we only had one car, so my dad would sometimes have to hitch rides or walk for long stretches of the 30-mile trip home from the shipyards where he worked.
One rainy night, Mom got worried. So we piled in the car and went out looking for him. When we found Dad walking along the road, he was soaking wet and shivering in his shirtsleeves. He explained that he had given his coat to a homeless man he’d met on the highway.
Why did he give away his only jacket? Dad told us the reason in the car that night: **“I knew when I left that man, he’d still be alone. But I could give him my coat,_because I knew you were coming for me_.”**
None of us succeed alone – when times are tough, we can persevere because our family, friends and neighbors will come for us.
[**Together, we are coming to build a better future for all Georgians, where they know they are supported by their leaders. Will you split a $5 contribution between me and Kirsten Gillibrand today toward our fight for opportunity for all Georgians?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44557649/342130747/821871378?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3400-bu-nd-v2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YmMzNmM3ZC02MWM1LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0kdolU0BRDm8nwgtJ6_wRcCSArXdIX4Ec9cTXJ_K5gU=)
I’m running for governor because I am ready to lead Georgia to its next and greatest chapter — where everyone has the opportunity to thrive, where Georgians will know that someone is coming for them, too.
[**The strength of this campaign lies in supporters like you who believe in a brighter future for all of Georgia. Please split a $5 contribution between Kirsten Gillibrand and my campaign right now to invest in a brighter future for our state.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44557651/342130749/821871378?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3400-bu-nd-v2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YmMzNmM3ZC02MWM1LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0kdolU0BRDm8nwgtJ6_wRcCSArXdIX4Ec9cTXJ_K5gU=)

subject: Your thoughts on the Second Amendment
body:
The far Left in America is attempting to rewrite our nation’s history and undermine our Constitution—with a special emphasis
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z64ak2rkqifsht4rnqgjf6dfoucjeto4hjs8pd20_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cjjm1o36chh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfccbiejhb9clmm9h31pphmcr3cdlgc4rb8srkclr77c9lepon6d9l6uqmfd37m1jt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or0e8o6cclimmq6fdj3coob1cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn49fg)
This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zc9to8ft96jsuockug2dsnnkvnej6eo01hvpgbq8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cjjm1o36chh2bs) Dear Friend of the Constitution, The far Left in America is attempting to rewrite our nation’s history and undermine our Constitution—with a special emphasis on eliminating the Second Amendment. Today, you’re receiving Hillsdale College’s **Second Amendment Survey** because you’re someone who understands that education is essential to the defense of liberty. We are reaching and teaching millions of Americans about the importance of liberty, and we are doing this without accepting even ONE PENNY of government funding. Could you take a few minutes to complete our **Second Amendment Survey** using the secure link below? **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ziqcm6r691v8ora25ht89posdl3u4dtn98beu4rg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cjjm1o36chh2bs "https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/")** Your timely survey answers will help us reach and teach millions of our fellow citizens in the coming year about the importance of liberty—which includes the rights protected by the Second Amendment. There is no question that one of the Left’s most powerful tools in its ongoing effort to undermine our liberty is **ignorance**. Here at Hillsdale, we have been pursuing truth and defending liberty since the College was founded in 1844. Today our educational outreach efforts include programs on a variety of topics essential to liberty, such as the Second Amendment. As constitutional scholar Edward J. Erler observed in _Imprimis_ , our digest of liberty that reaches millions of Americans: “The Second Amendment is an expression of **first principles**.” This means the Second Amendment is essential for the preservation of freedom. If we are denied the means of defending our freedom, we will eventually lose our freedom. This kind of thinking is foreign to most college and university campuses today, where “safe spaces” are now commonplace, and shooting clubs are nearly extinct. Here’s an example... Not long ago, the University of Virginia canceled its traditional 21-gun salute on Veterans Day. Why? The administration was concerned that firing guns in honor of those who served their country and did their part to defend our freedom would cause “panic” among the student body. Unfortunately, there are many more such examples I could cite to illustrate the disastrous effects of the ongoing decline in civics education in America. **But instead of just TALKING, it’s more important to DO something about it.** That’s why we have been working to expand our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. And this work continues today. That’s why I would like your answers to our brief **Second Amendment Survey.** You can complete the survey today at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4fav66k6tjtimgl16i3m3f19nfbbhkssef241eo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cjjm1o36chh2bs)** We believe that an educated citizenry is essential for the preservation of our liberty. As Ronald Reagan said, “Freedom is never more than one generation away from extinction.” Do you agree? I hope so. This is why we **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans about the principles of liberty and the Constitution. It’s also why we need your help today. As I mentioned, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation. Our independence from the government means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of citizens like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. It also means your gift really matters. **Today, you have a great opportunity to help preserve liberty—including the Second Amendment—for future generations.** After completing your **Second Amendment Survey** , please join me in the cause of liberty with your generous tax-deductible gift today. And, when you give a $100 gift or more, we’ll send you a special, limited-edition Hillsdale College hat as our thank you. This hat commemorates our partnership with USA Shooting, the organization dedicated to preparing the best American shooters to represent our country in the Olympics and Paralympics. But hurry—supplies are limited! Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed **Second Amendment Survey.** Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
**P.S.** Our Constitution—including the Second Amendment—is under attack today. Do you agree? Then please take our **Second Amendment Survey** at the secure link below. It will only take a few minutes, and your answers will help to preserve liberty for future generations. Thank you! **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zt60qfukpsgres94g0coffjosu6bjcmv1t4n255g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cjjm1o36chh2bs)**

But the woke Left and corporate right are trying to cancel her from Congress. It's the same old game. They can't beat her, so they're trying to destroy her.

body:
Dear Peter,

I've been kicked off Twitter.

I've been kicked off congressional committees.

**Now the radical socialist democrats even want to kick me off the ballot!**

**_Why?_** All because I speak my mind. Because I believe what the Constitution says. I believe in what our Founding Fathers fought and died for.

I believe in Free Speech.

**And to the radical socialists, that is just unacceptable.**

Will you stand with me today? **[Will you stand up for Free Speech](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60038361:suni_OHNc:m:1:2365227053:A5CC562A4DD07B9175027F1C9572C15B:r)?**

**Just look at what is going on all around us.**

Elon Musk says he wants to buy Twitter to make it freer and more open, and the left erupts.

Communist Democrats like Barack Obama even call for more censorship to "protect democracy."

Does Obama even understand just how asinine they sound?

**Pro-censorship leftists sound like Stalin or Mao.**

They want to crack down on free speech to protect us from ourselves. This is the philosophy of socialists and communists.

We can't let them continue to take away our freedoms.

That's why you and I MUST elect an America First majority to Congress this November.

**And why we've got to Stand for Freedom of Speech NOW.**

Because I'm not just fighting to return to congress, this fight is about much more than me alone.

This fight is about you, your family, and your neighbors.

It's about the very fabric of our nation.

**That's why I am traveling the country speaking at America First Rallies.**

| Dear Friend,
I find it shameful that the House of Representatives is debating a budget plan this week that does not include any tax cuts for Massachusetts residents.
Inflation is running at more than eight percent, the highest cost of living increase in a generation. Bay Staters are facing soaring prices on gas, groceries, and other goods. For Beacon Hill leaders to say that tax breaks 'weren't necessary' in the Budget is ludicrous.
Furthermore, as House leaders spend millions of dollars of taxpayer money on free phone calls for prisoners and eliminating probation and parole fees, I find it disgraceful - but not surprising - that our state's top law enforcement official, Attorney General Maura Healey, has remained silent in defense of law-abiding, taxpaying citizens.
This is a prime example of why having Maura Healey as Governor would ruin our state. Maura Healey won't stand up to progressive policies passed by the Legislature, she will embrace them. I'm not going to let that happen.
As Governor, I will work hard to realign priorities on Beacon Hill. I will block progressive policies that favor special interests and replace them with a different approach that always favors Massachusetts residents, their freedom, and their hard-earned taxpayer dollars.

**[Help us stop the endless Senate Sellouts by supporting SCF and our priority candidates today!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60236414:JSAvY-oNH:m:1:3317145305:D8A374BC2AFE852B53CC8F16F28C063D:r)**

Peter -

Did you hear the news?

**Elon Musk just bought Twitter!**

body:
You have my word:
| | |
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44570075/342179301/327283057?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=18326&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk883-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MzU5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YzI3ZTM0MC03MmM1LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=oxDLbjol-QzgkBGejP63p4e_KawVoUUZjv8-N6hL05Q=&emci=861a1e01-cab6-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=4c27e340-72c5-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=13784334)
Peter, throughout his time in Washington, Sen. Chuck Grassley (R-IA) has told Iowans time and again that he supports term limits for members of Congress. But it's been 47 years, nearly a half century, since Iowa first sent him there. After first serving three terms in the House, he moved on to the Senate where he is now running for an _eighth_ consecutive term.
Forty-seven years is too damn long – no matter who you are. **That's why you have my word on this: if I’m elected as Iowa's next senator, I will term-limit myself and serve no more than two terms. Period.**

I mean what I say. I'll get the job done, and quite frankly, I don't need – nor do I want! – 47 years in Washington to do it. In fact, there's no better example of why we need term limits than Sen. Grassley himself. After all his years in Congress, Sen. Grassley has left Iowa's working families behind. He's allowed protections for workers and unions to go on the chopping block. He's stood in lockstep with his party as they launched a coordinated attack on voting rights.
Making life better for those in your community isn't about the number of years you can rack up – or in Sen. Grassley's case, the fancy house you can buy in Washington, D.C. It's about seeing work to be done and _doing_ it. It's about dedication and willpower. It's about service.

| | **Why am I running?** It's what has guided all my professional decisions – service. I have a strong sense of duty and hope to offer Northern Michigan and the Upper Peninsula true, honest, and ethical representation. I'm confident I can be an effective member of Congress for the 1st District and guide us on a national and worldwide stage under the ideals and principles of what it means to be a proud American. I will run a bedrock of principles — wisdom, justice, courage, kindness, democratic freedom, and equality under the law. We all deserve a change. We deserve a Representative with a moral compass, integrity, someone who speaks the truth and tries to embody all that is best in this great district. We deserve a Congressman with a vision who can recognize problems on the horizon and develop reasonable solutions, someone who can build a consensus to achieve that vision. Members of my district deserve a member of Congress that listens and stands on certain principles that will guide my policy decisions.
* **I support universal healthcare, childcare, and the expansion of Medicaid and Medicare.** No one should suffer the consequences of not being able to afford access to medical care.

* When I look at my $200,000 hospital bills from a simple but bad gallbladder problem, I worry about those faced with a similar situation but without my resources.
* The world is still in a pandemic, and we must move forward together. Vaccination is the best strategy we have to address COVID. I am committed to advocating for science and data to inform our responses as we learn to live with the now more manageable disease.
* **I support sound environmental policies** to protect our future and especially for us, our Great Lakes. Like our Native American colleagues' Seventh Generation Principle, today's decisions should result in a sustainable world seven generations into the future.
* **I support jobs with living wages.** If an adult is working a full-time job, they should not have to count on food stamps to sustain their family.
* **I support critical investments in our infrastructure**. It will ignite the economy and bring much-needed jobs to our District – putting money in working families' pockets and food on the table, all without raising taxes.
* Especially important for Northern Michigan and the Upper Peninsula is Broadband expansion. A nation without rural connectivity is unacceptable. For our district, it will be an economic boom for businesses, jobs, and education, not to mention our quality of life.
* For many Michiganders and throughout the Nation, we have an affordable housing crisis. Unfortunately, housing costs have risen at rates that are outpacing stagnant salary growth. I want to be part of a national solution to this ongoing challenge in our district.
* **I support our democracy, election, and voters' rights.** I believe our democracy is stronger when it is accessible to as many eligible voters as possible, built on inclusion, equal treatment, and participation.

**Who I am** To start my career as a public servant, I thought it necessary to be well educated, so my master plan included obtaining advanced degrees in social work, public health, and medicine. I was blessed to be able to do it. I started my career in social work at a veteran's hospital, followed by three years working in Indian Health Service as a family physician. In 1989 I moved my family to the beautiful state of Michigan and practiced as a family physician in Marquette for two decades. My wife Peggy and I joined the State Department's Foreign Service 11 years ago, out of a sense of National duty. I served as a diplomat during tours in Pakistan, South Korea, Afghanistan, Morocco, and North Africa for ten years, followed by Iraq. After my last two-year tour in Iraq, I returned home to retire, but duty called again, and I became medical director for the health department during the worse pandemic our country has seen in 100 years. The United States is more divided economically, politically, and culturally than ever before. We are even divided on science. We need reasonable leaders who can unite. Who I am, what I support, and why I'm running for Congress – Dr. Bob Lorinser = We're on a= to the end of the month to hit an ambitious fundraising goal in our effort to unseat Jack Bergman. = = | | = | = | | | | | | | | Why am I running? It's what has guided all my professional decisions – service. I have a strong sense of duty and hope to offer Northern Michigan and the Upper Peninsula true, honest, and ethical representation. I'm confident I can be an effective member of Congress for the 1st District and guide us on a national and worldwide stage under the ideals and principles of what it means to be a proud American. I will run a bedrock of principles — wisdom, justice, courage, kindness, democratic freedom, and equality under the law. We all deserve a change. We deserve a Representative with a moral compass, integrity, someone who speaks the truth and tries to embody all that is best in this great district. We deserve a Congressman with a vision who can recognize problems on the horizon and develop reasonable solutions, someone who can build a consensus to achieve that vision. Members of my district deserve a member of Congress that listens and stands on certain principles that will guide my policy decisions. I support universal healthcare, childcare, and the expansion of Medicaid and Medicare. No one should suffer the consequences of not being able to afford access to medical care. When I look at my $200,000 hospital bills from a simple but bad gallbladder problem, I worry about those faced with a similar situation but without my resources. The world is still in a pandemic, and we must move forward together. Vaccination is the best strategy we have to address COVID. I am committed to advocating for science and data to inform our responses as we learn to live with the now more manageable disease. I support sound environmental policies to protect our future and especially for us, our Great Lakes. Like our Native American colleagues' Seventh Generation Principle, today's decisions should result in a sustainable world seven generations into the future. I support jobs with living wages. If an adult is working a full-time job, they should not have to count on food stamps to sustain their family. I support critical investments in our infrastructure. It will ignite the economy and bring much-needed jobs to our District – putting money in working families' pockets and food on the table, all without raising taxes. Especially important for Northern Michigan and the Upper Peninsula is Broadband expansion. A nation without rural connectivity is unacceptable. For our district, it will be an economic boom for businesses, jobs, and education, not to mention our quality of life. For many Michiganders and throughout the Nation, we have an affordable housing crisis. Unfortunately, housing costs have risen at rates that are outpacing stagnant salary growth. I want to be part of a national solution to this ongoing challenge in our district. I support our democracy, election, and voters' rights. I believe our democracy is stronger when it is accessible to as many eligible voters as possible, built on inclusion, equal treatment, and participation. = Who I am To start my career as a public servant, I thought it necessary to be well educated, so my master plan included obtaining advanced degrees in social work, public health, and medicine. I was blessed to be able to do it. I started my career in social work at a veteran's hospital, followed by three years working in Indian Health Service as a family physician. In 1989 I moved my family to the beautiful state of Michigan and practiced as a family physician in Marquette for two decades. My wife Peggy and I joined the State Department's Foreign Service 11 years ago, out of a sense of National duty. I served as a diplomat during tours in Pakistan, South Korea, Afghanistan, Morocco, and North Africa for ten years, followed by Iraq. After my last two-year tour in Iraq, I returned home to retire, but duty called again, and I became medical director for the health department during the worse pandemic our country has seen in 100 years. The United States is more divided economically, politically, and culturally than ever before. We are even divided on science. We need reasonable leaders who can unite. It's time to come together and push for government solutions that reflect the best of Northern Michigan's values and priorities. I strive to be a voice of reason in Washington. name: Dr. Neil Shah For Governor
subject: Let's Do Something Revolutionary
body:
| Peter -- These are exciting times for conservatives in America! Thanks to your support, and to the support of many thousands of conservative Minnesotans, we're looking at data that makes us one of the leading candidates for Governor. We are also **THE leading _conservative_ candidate** running to unseat the lockdown loving tyrant Tim Walz. If you were able to catch Walz' speech on Sunday, you'll have noticed how tough it will be to beat this liar. It is going to take a **great communicator** to dispel Walz' lies, and hold him accountable for what he's done to Minnesota. **He NEEDS to be held accountable.** The Walz State of the State Address served as a victory speech on COVID, but only after a **Strong Republican** running to replace him made it a political necessity. He even had the audacity to dismiss 'disagreements' and 'struggles' of the past few years. These were not mere disagreements, but rather everyday people fighting back as his regime **forced injections into your body, needlessly set back your kids' education, and threw innocent people behind bars.** The Walz path to victory depends on Minnesotans forgetting the destruction he caused, and looking toward false promises of better times ahead. We will not let people forget! **Sadly, even some Republicans are beginning to forget what Walz did to us** , and what he'll continue to do to us if we send a weak Republican to challenge him in November. Some of my opponents are even going back to supporting unilateral emergency powers! We KNOW these cannot stay in place. Some more moderate and politically safe proposals include 30 days of emergency powers. **Do conservatives believe a governor can shut down churches for 30 days?** **Do parents believe we can force kids out of school for another 30 days?** **Do my Republican opponents really believe it's okay to suspend the constitution for 30 days?** After over a year of lockdowns, believing this can and should happen again is unacceptable! We know that when you give politicians an inch, they'll take ten miles. We need a principled conservative who will stand up for what we believe in, not grow softer and softer as November approaches. Tim Walz took time in his speech to warn listeners against catchy slogans like **_Save Sota_** and _**Never Again**_ , because he sees us as a threat! Walz also warned people to leave no room for argument or differing opinions. You won't need to look very far to find Republican establishment career politicians parroting the same protective phrases to distract you from their abysmal records. Be careful! If a Republican is using the same talking points as Walz, they're probably a RINO. Our campaign is mobilizing a grassroots machine that is fired up and ready to win in November. We've built a coalition of lifetime constitutional conservatives, political newcomers, and former Democrats and Independents who understand we need to do something different to save our state. Our grassroots team is also recruiting people to serve as election judges. [Don't forget to sign up to be an election judge before May 1st!](https://electneil.nationbuilder.com/r?u=FHnL8ikUv8WviObJjkW8kTR7ozFiVSYhzSu-2EwIkQBX7-pZsfqppkmeG6bRooyWyOz1cUyk2pbEgecQN77ddjSKYNQ4b3ZhsgJJI-dm9WGJoRfvK6sloppmNv49fpxLkLgZLOsaIMSJmbv5-krIng&e=d39b8e369eb2bbdd6f36e913aaadeb34&utm_source=electneil&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=revolutionary_in_rochester&n=1) **We have a historic opportunity this fall.** We can listen to career politicians and send someone who will forget about lockdowns and vaccine mandates, or **we can send a conservative champion who will fight to preserve freedom for generations to come!** [](https://electneil.nationbuilder.com/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRYb5HwtNn73BDblePU410AX&e=d39b8e369eb2bbdd6f36e913aaadeb34&utm_source=electneil&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=revolutionary_in_rochester&n=2) We won't win if we repeat the same failed plays. Instead - **Let's do something Revolutionary this May.** Let's send an authentic and principled outsider, and save our state from the tyranny of the political class. We CANNOT let Walz win and Liberty die. Let's fight! Thank you, Dr. Neil Shah Conservative Candidate for Governor [ElectNeil.com](https://electneil.nationbuilder.com/r?u=iUaD1gacZHU3dYzSqkV0rOkbRklTyTNtmBTRPmVdijk&e=d39b8e369eb2bbdd6f36e913aaadeb34&utm_source=electneil&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=revolutionary_in_rochester&n=3)

The course features Hillsdale College’s world-renowned faculty. It concludes by setting forth how limited government under the Constitution might be revived. “Constitution 101” is modeled after the course that all Hillsdale students are required to take, and this DVD box set is your opportunity to experience it for yourself. I hope you take advantage of this offer, and I have included a secure link for you here: [**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/constitution-101-dvd/**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zmqeftpevsq3fimvlmj16hgocb7hbdnq0h5ur5pg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cjge1o70sph2bs) As you know, Hillsdale takes no government funding, even indirectly in the form of student grants or loans. So, your support is essential to expanding our national educational outreach efforts, like free online courses, designed to restore and defend liberty. As I mentioned above, supplies of the new “Constitution 101” DVD box set are limited, so I hope you’ll reserve your copy today. Sincerely, Bill Gray Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth--Defending Liberty since 1844

Peter,
**Of all the things my dad taught me before he passed away, to this day the most important lesson has always been: education saves lives.** If you have a moment, I’d like to tell you a story about my father, John King Sr., who served as New York City's first Black deputy superintendent. Or if you aren’t able to read this right now, I hope you’ll consider pitching in a contribution to support our campaign: _**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/king_siri_em](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44575755/342193925/1974957641?source=email-ngp-20220426-b1_fr_full-TK_S1_C1&&&&refcode=email-ngp-20220426-b1_fr_full-TK_S1_C1&&&&utm_medium=email&&&&utm_source=ngp&&&&utm_campaign=20220426&&&&utm_content=b1_fr_full&&&&utm_term=TK_S1_C1&&&&amount=25&refcode2=574545c3-7ac5-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NzQ1NDVjMy03YWM1LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2biVDDSNsFvkzon9q19GV7CFH0nrnj_3Qle0_HEY3nE=)**_
When I was very young, my dad would always tell me about a time early in his teaching career when he broke his wrist playing in a basketball game on a weekend. On the following Monday, when he came in to teach his class, the school principal told him to go home because there was some sort of rule that you couldn’t teach with a cast on.
My father calmly went over to the counter in the main office, smashed the cast on the counter, brushed the pieces in the trash, put his hand in his pocket, and continued to teach his class. Broken wrist or not, my dad wasn’t going to let his students miss a single day of learning on his account.
**Whenever someone in our family said something was too hard or too difficult, my dad would tell that story.** For him, the most important thing he could do that day and any day thereafter was to be in his classroom with his students.
It’s the passion and belief in students of educators like my dad that inspired me to become a teacher myself. Education saves lives because of those who provide it, and when I had the privilege to serve as U.S. Secretary of Education under President Obama, I worked hard to ensure teachers, education support professionals, and everyone who makes education possible got the recognition they deserve.
Now, I continue to look up to my dad and all the amazing educators in my life as inspiration for this campaign for governor. But I can’t win this race without your support, Peter. _**[Please, can I count on you to donate $5 to our grassroots movement to bring real progress to Maryland?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44575756/342193926/1974957641?source=email-ngp-20220426-b1_fr_full-TK_S1_C1&&&&refcode=email-ngp-20220426-b1_fr_full-TK_S1_C1&&&&utm_medium=email&&&&utm_source=ngp&&&&utm_campaign=20220426&&&&utm_content=b1_fr_full&&&&utm_term=TK_S1_C1&&&&amount=5&refcode2=574545c3-7ac5-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NzQ1NDVjMy03YWM1LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2biVDDSNsFvkzon9q19GV7CFH0nrnj_3Qle0_HEY3nE=)**_

King Sr., and how a quality education changed the trajectory of his entire family. = “Dr. John King to be Named Associate Superintendent — First of Race in Job” The New York Times, July 21, 1959 His father’s commitment to his students served as inspiration throughout John’s career as a teacher, principal, and President Obama’s Secretary of Education – and if elected governor, it will be the backbone of his plan to give educators a seat at the table and transform our public schools into world-class institutions. = | | | = | = | = | | = | = | = | = Thanks for all that you do, Team King \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: John King <info@johnkingforgovernor.com> Date: Mon, Apr 25, 2022 at 10:30 AM Subject: Education saves lives To: <dpwillis67@gmail.com> Peter, Of all the things my dad taught me before he passed away, to this day the most important lesson has always been: education saves lives. If you have a moment, I’d like to tell you a story about my father, John King Sr., who served as New York City's first Black deputy superintendent. Or if you aren’t able to read this right now, I hope you’ll consider pitching in a contribution to support our campaign: = When I was very young, my dad would always tell me about a time early in his teaching career when he broke his wrist playing in a basketball game on a weekend. On the following Monday, when he came in to teach his class, the school principal told him to go home because there was some sort of rule that you couldn’t teach with a cast on. My father calmly went over to the counter in the main office, smashed the cast on the counter, brushed the pieces in the trash, put his hand in his pocket, and continued to teach his class. Broken wrist or not, my dad wasn’t going to let his students miss a single day of learning on his account. Whenever someone in our family said something was too hard or too difficult, my dad would tell that story. For him, the most important thing he could do that day and any day thereafter was to be in his classroom with his students. It’s the passion and belief in students of educators like my dad that inspired me to become a teacher myself. Education saves lives because of those who provide it, and when I had the privilege to serve as U.S. Secretary of Education under President Obama, I worked hard to ensure teachers, education support professionals, and everyone who makes education possible got the recognition they deserve. Now, I continue to look up to my dad and all the amazing educators in my life as inspiration for this campaign for governor. But I can’t win this race without your support, Peter. = | = I’m respectfully asking you to join scores of teachers, public school parents, and education leaders who agree it’s time for a teacher in the governor’s mansion. I know that together, we can create lasting and positive change. subject: The GOP Pennsylvania Senate Debate Last Night Proved It...
body:
---
| | | | | | [ ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001rB5h2WmxNv2fg3senKO6kmyp9ihNi-Fb0r_kaQDrfEjSJL-IGLwxba5j5bAIsu0hhoYxFuc5MV9l7aqHZ8vWymeY70rXrkby6bMnnQXAOrFu9W5TKGiDHH71AhU_VWWYkPX5TJKwb4veALuhiAiLrQi4p6JF7yFDjIzMkdtQi_C6Uy-jRlID0Q==&c=H5pZuqRheiwB4-s52JonLzRniyoidqWeoib-xCzfAPQO_sMzjwvh3Q==&ch=YINtYSqNxGU-ORdrGNkRsYslIQmyYUwy7ziA8UhQC-WUWMgYBb3RsQ==)
---
| Peter \-
Did you see me in the debates last night? If you did then you probably saw it for what it was -- an opportunity for everyone who doesn't follow this campaign to finally see what YOU'VE seen all along.
It is now more clear than ever that this is the only campaign featuring a REAL America First conservative. All over our country we have RINOs running who SAY they're America First candidates without actually BEING America First, and the race for this seat is full of them. The people of Pennsylvania are too smart to be fooled by these carpetbaggers coming into town and saying that they're just like them.
---
| [ ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001rB5h2WmxNv2fg3senKO6kmyp9ihNi-Fb0r_kaQDrfEjSJL-IGLwxba5j5bAIsu0hhoYxFuc5MV9l7aqHZ8vWymeY70rXrkby6bMnnQXAOrFu9W5TKGiDHH71AhU_VWWYkPX5TJKwb4veALuhiAiLrQi4p6JF7yFDjIzMkdtQi_C6Uy-jRlID0Q==&c=H5pZuqRheiwB4-s52JonLzRniyoidqWeoib-xCzfAPQO_sMzjwvh3Q==&ch=YINtYSqNxGU-ORdrGNkRsYslIQmyYUwy7ziA8UhQC-WUWMgYBb3RsQ==)
---
| After last night, it's safe to say that we only have two other opponents in this race -- and they're BOTH members of Klaus Schwab's World Economic Forum (who doesn't have your best interests in mind). You know that, I know that, and now everybody else who watched the debate last night is waking up to that.
Today we keep doing what we've been doing. We keep pushing, we keep fighting. This campaign is able to even send this message out because of the work that YOU'VE put in. We're not done yet.
This race is for one of the most important seats in our nation. We CANNOT sleep on this, we MUST keep fighting! My opponents have spent MILLIONS against me because they have the backing of Klaus Schwab and his dystopian World Economic Forum, and if we don't win this then he'll own this seat. This campaign is funded by YOU. I am YOU! I am a regular person fighting against the globalist machine.
---
| | | [KEEP FIGHTING HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001rB5h2WmxNv2fg3senKO6kmyp9ihNi-Fb0r_kaQDrfEjSJL-IGLwxba5j5bAIsu0hhoYxFuc5MV9l7aqHZ8vWymeY70rXrkby6bMnnQXAOrFu9W5TKGiDHH71AhU_VWWYkPX5TJKwb4veALuhiAiLrQi4p6JF7yFDjIzMkdtQi_C6Uy-jRlID0Q==&c=H5pZuqRheiwB4-s52JonLzRniyoidqWeoib-xCzfAPQO_sMzjwvh3Q==&ch=YINtYSqNxGU-ORdrGNkRsYslIQmyYUwy7ziA8UhQC-WUWMgYBb3RsQ==)
---
|
As we saw, my opponents are terrified of our campaign and try to tear me down. They CANNOT make a dent in this campaign, but, I need you to step up and make sure of that. I know you've already done so much, but I know there's more fight left in you. If you're able to contribute anything at the link above, I need you to know that this campaign will utilize your resources FOR you just as we have been.
Thank you again for everything you've done for this campaign, and you can catch me on the next debates TONIGHT at 7pm ET.
Blessings, Kathy Barnette
---

---
| Kathy Barnette for Senate

In case you were wondering why you may not have heard from me before now, it’s because I lost in 2020 by less than 11,000 votes in what became one of the closest congressional races in the 2020 election. | [](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=d00d2c72fdd549d083985e516aff2046&_e=q-CrgHor43jfsDCmz16vLOJH3zU2c1pl_U3fCvn19SJUpnFuDwVonvU3BheVwOr3elZykKc2Va2QoCFYqYSh8pXafkmPfCbwJlPC48IoypVJxkBsceQSytyHVWqFsEZIf00SWtsCoF3OwnSAKdWcEt96-cnFohuIGk-zPC5xK1pUX9Sku7fSU9PdeaHLy3SjOz6eBisolZSoYE9MbDdnJbvHtY2__4Y1sLLvV2oVXgVouF0dx4d3FWhjx0_62RuMZH2GTkhRP4rRmbW7eDQIDgv7-r4lPweLPSLgIIuBcrX6NMTWDtQ8OvciTtBCjCqHULGMa9EgUCdBvKrl-zn6SuWf34yhcT5Xqf3ZzYCZ65cBXczwUz8GYKvxHPT5QQP6)

Fellow American,

When I joined the Marine Corps in 2011, it became apparent that my calling in life was service: _Service to my country, service to my family, service to all Americans._

I decided there and then that my purpose was to do something that mattered – beyond myself. Something that would help people.

So, I did just that. I served nine years in the Marine Corps, four overseas tours, and remain in the reserves – ready to help if I’m needed.

Before you click out of this email, allow me to persuade you not to; My name is Tyler Kistner and I’m asking for just a few moments of your time today. **As a favor to a veteran, please read this entire email.**

The year that I joined the marines was coincidentally the same time that I became increasingly concerned about the direction our country was headed towards.

_Politicians that only served themselves._

_A currency that was becoming meaningless due to inflation._

_Restrictions enforced by unelected bureaucrats._

I’m 34 years old; a husband and a father to two beautiful children. I don’t have a famous last name, I’m not a minority candidate and the craziest thing I’ve done in my life before is to run for Congress. In case you were wondering why you may not have heard from me before now, it’s **because I lost in 2020 by less than 11,000 votes** in what became one of the closest congressional races in the 2020 election.

[**When I decided to run for Congress the first time, I knew things would be tough.**](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=d00d2c72fdd549d083985e516aff2046&_e=q-CrgHor43jfsDCmz16vLOJH3zU2c1pl_U3fCvn19SJUpnFuDwVonvU3BheVwOr3elZykKc2Va2QoCFYqYSh8pXafkmPfCbwJlPC48IoypVJxkBsceQSytyHVWqFsEZIf00SWtsCoF3OwnSAKdWcEt96-cnFohuIGk-zPC5xK1rNRXTicOAiaASzKB1dzrAS57sXA8uwPthP1jfi13VWpZUWYJbddI9rgX_1zCL5XIixfmHuXPKKXZ12uqD6EHewQ2ab9_wET2U6xz7CoamNKLK4VWrc5HEeQa7Wq4Tg9kFTuaqkSY4YgAf7Xx93qPOnXUWEddwunH7L7oJDlOFyylglEU1b-lshHZk9Z1RIzmCL9kHyvgK73yKRyYf14x0T) I didn’t have the resources, knowledge, or background in politics. Heck! I didn’t even have a campaign manager. But as it turns out, other Americans were on the same page as me – we didn’t need another self-serving politician in Washington! My message resonated with people, and we ran a historic campaign, losing to a well-funded Democrat by just 2%.

I’m running to unseat the same Democrat once again – and like last time, she’s very well-funded. Hi, Derek, it’s Michigan state Senator Mallory McMorrow.

That’s because on Tuesday, after reading a fundraising email sent by a Republican colleague where I was accused of wanting to “groom and sexualize children” for defending LGBTQ+ rights, I took to the Michigan Senate floor to defend myself and the marginalized communities Republicans love attacking :

As a Michigan state Senator, I’ve seen just how far state Republicans are willing to go to pass their backward agenda , and I know that if we can elect more Democrats to our statehouses, we can stop them.
Will you stand with me and chip in a $25 split donation to the DLCC and the CommonGood? Electing Democrats to serve in state legislatures nationwide is the key to fighting back against state Republicans’ hateful crusade . But in Michigan, we’re already on edge – we have four special elections next month for critical seats in our state legislature. Electing Democrats to these seats is crucial to defending against a right-wing takeover. We cannot stand by and let state Republicans continue their ruthless attacks – and we cannot let hate win. Fighting back against hate starts with committed Democrats like you, [] Derek. Will you split a $25 donation today between DLCC and CommonGood to support state Democrats in this year’s midterm elections? | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE TUESDAY, APRIL 26
LOEFFLER OP-ED: BIDEN MUST CHANGE COURSE TO PREEMPT FOOD SHORTAGE
ATLANTA - In case you missed it, Greater Georgia Chairwoman and former U.S. Senator Kelly Loeffler penned an [op-ed](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001BoEViHX1y0Oxmt95-j79-nQ2N5PTudW-pNYKVIrvXAkYdGrBUiPemM_mJ5Gy0NUHlHVbeeebnjJYLM2APGVLrLKtG3IfRRqbiQy46FFMbxST3XPbi2IRikCkwinEkLgGkCjd58V7e2SaTumvkMsAuDVTKsUnbqJpgeoLycCoAe_uMcly5wqvvNX180izOKWVLGYYod4R0pCQVwtP8Nik-hre5NPLCzVMSEItzPN4Qf4aLYmtOrmR4hQuAuSNyzC5qOgGyPrZm2Y8lFot8T_6pQ==&c=d3haAoeexV4GBat4iaH_j3xuVtstERiS9ajzu1zpQcmvzfRNkB6BOA==&ch=wMLJembPO4O31NpxK5rxMBFHgQqReHfI3EA87v-zOmI-zw8l-JiShw==) for the Washington Examiner yesterday discussing the urgent threat of America's impending food shortage and the liberal policies that have pushed our nation to the brink of an inflationary and supply chain crisis. Read the full text of Kelly's op-ed below:
[Biden must change course to preempt food shortage](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001BoEViHX1y0Oxmt95-j79-nQ2N5PTudW-pNYKVIrvXAkYdGrBUiPemM_mJ5Gy0NUHlHVbeeebnjJYLM2APGVLrLKtG3IfRRqbiQy46FFMbxST3XPbi2IRikCkwinEkLgGkCjd58V7e2SaTumvkMsAuDVTKsUnbqJpgeoLycCoAe_uMcly5wqvvNX180izOKWVLGYYod4R0pCQVwtP8Nik-hre5NPLCzVMSEItzPN4Qf4aLYmtOrmR4hQuAuSNyzC5qOgGyPrZm2Y8lFot8T_6pQ==&c=d3haAoeexV4GBat4iaH_j3xuVtstERiS9ajzu1zpQcmvzfRNkB6BOA==&ch=wMLJembPO4O31NpxK5rxMBFHgQqReHfI3EA87v-zOmI-zw8l-JiShw==)
In America, the availability of everyday goods such as groceries and gasoline is generally a given. Even in 2020, amid the fallout of a pandemic, well-documented shortages were relatively short-lived. But as the economy recovered heading into 2021, the shift in Washington toward Democratic policies may now make hunger pangs familiar in a way unseen since the Great Depression.
While America is the world's breadbasket, reliance on Russian and Ukrainian wheat, barley, fertilizer, and, most of all, energy has made every mouthful cost more, as have increased regulations and taxes on our farmers here at home. Russia and Ukraine [produce](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001BoEViHX1y0Oxmt95-j79-nQ2N5PTudW-pNYKVIrvXAkYdGrBUiPemM_mJ5Gy0NUHr00ltuOvWpR40t0h5S_tqbyY7exdmSP5YWIl9vMXj_Snc26ycYUjBgwD6JPu_yw_cuDr-WYGQVTcKGMwHQymlBdokTlj7dqJo8gepMx8Eb-fl0koLSQsHGfPMunPhyStA4eOBh2ZxwUhBTO2Z_F9VT1Z7gjT8IszasAzi9RvDxdyYiyHUyg4TnSQcDTvYNj_7bi0vzMwxhQ=&c=d3haAoeexV4GBat4iaH_j3xuVtstERiS9ajzu1zpQcmvzfRNkB6BOA==&ch=wMLJembPO4O31NpxK5rxMBFHgQqReHfI3EA87v-zOmI-zw8l-JiShw==) 25% of the world's wheat, and Russia exports 20% of the world's natural gas supply, both vital to the food supply chain. Russian President Vladimir Putin's invasion has disrupted these exports and left the world in a precarious position.
A recent article in Parade [listed](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001BoEViHX1y0Oxmt95-j79-nQ2N5PTudW-pNYKVIrvXAkYdGrBUiPemM_mJ5Gy0NUHKLJzUnmg8ZY3hwbrWTu422DS8ii6DqpVvTmzIJ8y3IRIYV4xsry8rijpzbBB9UG84lUSwLxkUlmjWoX364ch02WLDEmPZlMBlqwrQJqRchnGukcocA0XqGEne2oTqdV0MKPguV5RJsQ=&c=d3haAoeexV4GBat4iaH_j3xuVtstERiS9ajzu1zpQcmvzfRNkB6BOA==&ch=wMLJembPO4O31NpxK5rxMBFHgQqReHfI3EA87v-zOmI-zw8l-JiShw==) basically every food as at risk of being in short supply in 2022, from eggs and dairy to produce and meat, but then laughably blamed climate change as one of the key causes. Particularly since shortages will be felt most by the more than 10% of Americans who are food insecure, President Joe Biden should be working to avert this looming crisis. Instead, he shrugs and [says](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001BoEViHX1y0Oxmt95-j79-nQ2N5PTudW-pNYKVIrvXAkYdGrBUiPemM_mJ5Gy0NUHigybUAst-YHntBgyqXmZW1wy8eJvk7ud1jEmkY00_eqqRa47L3LrUS4Q79ZThsDgC1MOKSmDi27zYbB-emlh13Bo8r4f2tSlsrzrRIpd9rdM_-jou9ntrO_8T-BSk21OB4vv4GgiGIzabsU9GAmRo6OJD-xaj0qH3eF91d1Cc4UVPS9h_jbRQChCZt4kTwETe9wUqfu5kfbZTKhlnVC3lw==&c=d3haAoeexV4GBat4iaH_j3xuVtstERiS9ajzu1zpQcmvzfRNkB6BOA==&ch=wMLJembPO4O31NpxK5rxMBFHgQqReHfI3EA87v-zOmI-zw8l-JiShw==) , "With regard to food shortage, it's going to be real," and then plays the solutionless blame game.
The buck never seems to stop at this president's desk, but facts speak louder than spin. Biden's harsh regulatory policies, trillions in reckless government spending, and his insistence on paying people not to work have triggered rampant inflation. Russia's aggression threw fuel on the fire, but it doesn't singularly explain away the price of beef shooting up 16%, the price of poultry increasing 13%, or the [recent rationing](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001BoEViHX1y0Oxmt95-j79-nQ2N5PTudW-pNYKVIrvXAkYdGrBUiPemM_mJ5Gy0NUHZPdmlbq4L8KaRFWsTYxol7si32RzrhCACz1-XOUz-Wm4duqBCeIInKyltjnJPEHkWlosKVfOF8vaxuidjFA-5XaJjFZFiVTy_48CO4O5--mf7OSfZxTImP4gYjM-9ZRUnoLSLZi56mLldY2pRGoX__MkvY5BsABl2amxaofKIfe-Yo8sTOtx6Mm-aBdb7Axa18ECXsJzmWGQBkfKAT-mArUijhKAOm4AawoXfO4jSq4=&c=d3haAoeexV4GBat4iaH_j3xuVtstERiS9ajzu1zpQcmvzfRNkB6BOA==&ch=wMLJembPO4O31NpxK5rxMBFHgQqReHfI3EA87v-zOmI-zw8l-JiShw==) of baby formula, not to mention skyrocketing wages shouldered by small businesses, which employ the majority of the public today.
Here in Georgia, farmers now pay over $1,400 for the same $400 bag of fertilizer they bought two years ago, in part because petroleum products are a key fertilizer ingredient. That is just one example of many products, such as diesel, seed, and equipment, the price spikes of which are exceeding gains in commodity prices. Supply and demand dynamics for all commodities, the building blocks of food, clothing, and fuel, will be discussed in 2022 like we've not seen in decades.
When the administration "helped" farmers by making it more difficult to keep animals and use water on their land, it made it more costly to produce food. Rising prices borne by families aren't a concern of the elites, with Bloomberg [telling](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001BoEViHX1y0Oxmt95-j79-nQ2N5PTudW-pNYKVIrvXAkYdGrBUiPemM_mJ5Gy0NUHedgufI-4zNhad2Pd8reMTY1ZCpjy5O7q-ZrfW1q2GY2Vp74obFPyD2930_ZNeb6F0RkTM04a5JuwNhs8iA41z-HnObx-mu0lfLSBSiAKnC_MAX9CqtvAZmN9tLcpwK82mEqItZVL-XTzfPeGzo9hjo_eW1gLEYKbOfVNBJEtwZXkSWuy5GBT7cXZWNA7AYH0JycnuWsAQfU=&c=d3haAoeexV4GBat4iaH_j3xuVtstERiS9ajzu1zpQcmvzfRNkB6BOA==&ch=wMLJembPO4O31NpxK5rxMBFHgQqReHfI3EA87v-zOmI-zw8l-JiShw==) us to try lentils instead of meat.
The Biden administration's irresponsible policies threaten to leave grocery shelves even more bare than during the pandemic. Democrats in Congress play their part in the Kabuki theater, too, hauling in energy and agriculture executives for what amounts to show trials, hoping we forget that Biden inherited a nation that was a net exporter of oil for the first time in 80 years, where food stamp usage hit a record low, and where the post-pandemic economy was starting to boom.
Sen. Elizabeth Warren, a Massachusetts Democrat, has even attacked grocery stores for rising prices, as if they haven't seen their costs rise. Finger-pointing and climate schemes won't make food more affordable or save the many family farms and other small businesses in danger of being lost in the inflation wave.
More regulation and bureaucracy, which Biden continues to roll out as the solution to our problems, has tightened the screws on farmers tilling our soil just as climate schemes such as canceling the Keystone Pipeline and banning drilling on federal lands have hurt thousands who work in the only industry that can reasonably provide energy security for all. The longer Democrats cling to big-government policies, the more likely it is that Biden's prophecy of a real food shortage will be self-fulfilling.
Recently, a reporter asked former President Barack Obama if he had anything to say to Democrats worried about their fate in the midterm elections. "We got a story to tell," he replied. "Just got to tell it." But the story they have to tell is of a president, whose party controls both the House and the Senate, with an uncanny knack for making things worse, not better, with every move.
We are walking a tightrope between prosperity and a bleak future of fuel and food shortages. Unless we get back to putting the needs of the public ahead of the needs of activists on their Twitter feeds, we will be coping with the consequences of Biden's reckless policies for years to come.

body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vW3er5OH5N

Hillsdale has a new video we'd like to share with you today. It's
the trailer for our newest free online course, "C.S. Lewis on
Christianity," which we're releasing next month. I'd like you to
be one of the first people to see this video preview. You can
watch your video and pre-register for the new course below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oW3er5OH5N

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
Friend,

Hillsdale
has a new video we'd like to share with you today. It's the
trailer for our newest free online course, "C.S. Lewis on
Christianity," which we're releasing next month.

I'd like
you to be one of the first people to see this video preview. You
can watch your video and pre-register for the new course below:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/cs-lewis-christianity-preregister/

C.S.
Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions
through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to
read.

His
signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has
inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more
believers to renew and deepen their faith-making him perhaps the
most important apologist of the twentieth century.

That's
why we are producing this new course, "C.S. Lewis on
Christianity." The goal is to share his profound insights on the
central topics of Christianity, including:

good
and evil,

conversion and faith,

prayer and the Bible,

suffering and death,

heaven and hell, and much more.

But how
do you explore the depths of Lewis's writings on these
fundamental topics in a seven-lecture course?

This is
also why we're thrilled to have Dr. Michael Ward-one of the
leading scholars of C.S. Lewis-as the instructor for the new
course.

Dr. Ward
is a distinguished teaching fellow at Hillsdale College and a
professor of theology at the University of Oxford. He is the
author of Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of
C.S. Lewis and After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis's The
Abolition of Man, and the co-editor of The Cambridge Companion to
C.S. Lewis. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford
home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

After
watching the trailer, I hope you'll want to join us and learn
from C.S. Lewis by pre-registering for this free online course.
You can easily do so on the same page as the video.

This
course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's
beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey
from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity
for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of the
Christian faith.

That's
why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of
Christianity with C.S. Lewis-enjoy your sneak peek!

Best
regards,

Kyle
Murnen, '09
Director
of Online Learning
Hillsdale
College

P.S.
There's one more thing: Will you also consider giving a special
tax-deductible gift to help promote "C.S. Lewis on Christianity"
to millions of Americans nationwide?

Your
generous gift will help us reach our $500,000 funding goal by May
16 to promote this course and our other educational efforts, like
Imprimis and our classical K-12 education programs.

As you
may know, Hillsdale College refuses EVERY PENNY of government
funding-even indirectly in the form of federal or state student
loans and grants. That means that these courses, along with
everything else we do here, are only possible because of friends
like YOU.

The initiative follows an Army mandate that soldiers go through training on gender identity and pronouns. name: Ben Shapiro
subject: 9 Antifa Leftists arrested
body:
Insidious leftist ideology has taken hold of our educational system. It’s never been more important that we expose it, bec
[View this message in your browser](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zuhpcn1j95er19ekngb7246coi1fprvearvdjuog_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk5p7atdge5p78d5jmeqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbrr4p5n6gqe4tbhmgomep3i64qe1ddj6pg6ecb1cipjctb3cqob0slhesrmacbnmv970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6o3i61j35d5l6djrcoj662ob4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp238h1e8he4933clg69p73c1h68oh5u)
Fellow Patriot, Insidious leftist ideology has taken hold of our educational system. It’s never been more important that we expose it, because the Left has lit an ideological fire, and that fire is now consuming the minds of young Americans, burning itself through the most aspects of American culture and politics. That’s why it’s of utmost importance that I hear back from you today. I’m no stranger to the authoritarian attitudes on campus; I famously felt the brunt of it when conservative students invited me to speak on the University of California, Berkeley campus. [**HELP US FIGHT THE RADICAL LEFT**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zupl9l0hgbqlaq0pqsrt1uaonell8rongqgf50b0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cjie6o32chh2bs) Radical leftist groups like Antifa vowed to riot and cause harm to others. The fear of violence from leftist agitators was so great that:
* It cost $600,000 in security expenses and required hundreds of policemen to ensure that agitators didn’t disrupt or try to cause violence at my speech.
* The University shut down six buildings on campus during my speech and erected concrete barricades (YES, a wall) to secure the Berkeley campus.
* For the first time in 20 years, the City of Berkeley voted to allow the use of pepper spray against violent protesters.
* In the end, police arrested nine leftists for trying to sneak banned weapons into our event—with the likely intent to do harm.

It’s no longer just about the Left trying to suppress your conservative views on campus. It’s about using the threat of violence to silence the conservative values you and I share. Meanwhile, schools roll out the red carpet for leftists like Angela Davis, Bill Ayers, Barack Obama, Bill Clinton, and Bernie Sanders. At Berkeley, taxpayer-funded school administrators tried to derail my event from even taking place. They told me that they didn’t have a lecture hall available, which was a lie. School administrators even cut the venue in half by not allowing students to sit in the balcony—a dirty tactic to minimize attendance. _**The good news is the radical Left’s attempts to silence me completely backfired.**_**** More than 600 students showed up, and we were able to host an engaging and civil event. Then, OVER 10 MILLION PEOPLE watched my speech online (that’s more viewers than any of the major evening newscasts). This victory for the Conservative Movement would have never happened if it weren’t for the **Young America’s Foundation** **(YAF)**. When Berkeley tried to illegally block me from coming to campus, YAF sued the university —**and won.** But the radicals who rioted and tried to incite violence at Berkeley are relentless. Their stranglehold on America’s universities has not yet been broken. **Young America’s Foundation** has been an incredible partner in making sure I am able to share our conservative values with students on campuses across the country. In fact, I speak on campuses **_exclusively_** through YAF because I know YAF has the experience and leadership necessary to run the nation’s leading campus lecture program. Today YAF needs your help. **[Will you contribute $35 today to ensure that YAF can continue to present speakers, including Dr. Arthur Laffer, Katie Pavlich, Senator Ted Cruz, and many others to high school and college students? Without you, the mission to pass along our conservative values to future generations will stall out.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zdfpoou48k7qc3q85ut1nljj9inavvrm3tp4k2ag_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cjie6o32chh2bs)** Let me tell you a little bit more about what YAF does to advance conservative ideas. Speaking to an audience of Young America’s Foundation students, Vice President Mike Pence noted, “Since its founding in 1960, YAF has been a bulwark of American greatness.” YAF valiantly defends the values we share by educating impressionable young people who have been ideologically poisoned by leftist propaganda for decades, by the very teachers and professors they’re told to trust. YAF’s team is the best at what they do. They are _**#1: the LARGEST and MOST effective conservative youth outreach organization in America**._ Here’s why:
* YAF introduces young audiences to the biggest names in the Conservative Movement through their leading campus lecture program. YAF speakers are the most inspiring conservative voices in America, including **Arthur Laffer, Katie Pavlich,** YAF’s Ronald Reagan Presidential Scholar and Vice President **Mike Pence, Dinesh D’Souza, Lila Rose, Steve Forbes,** Lt. Col.**Allen West** , Speaker**Newt Gingrich, Michael Knowles, Dana Loesch, James O’Keefe,** NFL star and Congressman **Burgess Owens, Star Parker,** Fox News’s**Jesse Watters,** and many others.
* YAF teaches **_millions of students_ **across the nation YOUR conservative values through breakthrough conferences, training seminars, and campus activism initiatives and activities. (In fact, YAF is the only Conservative Movement organization that has a full suite of conservative educational programs for high school students!)
* And YAF preserves and protects President Reagan’s ranch in Santa Barbara, California and Boyhood Home in Dixon, Illinois. They saved these national treasures so young people can learn about Ronald Reagan’s lasting accomplishments.

_No other organization reaches conservative students with foundational American ideas on a bigger scale than Young America’s Foundation._ _That’s why I prefer YAF to be my sole sponsor for campus events._ They fight for the right to ensure alternative voices are heard on college campuses. They stop campuses from being turned into Leftist echo chambers. I am glad I have YAF on my side and the side of the students. But YAF can’t do this alone. As the Left continues to stoop to desperate new lows to silence conservatives, it’s become more important than ever that our values are shared with the next generation of thought leaders. We both know that the Left doesn’t want a fair discussion of ideas. But that’s why YAF needs your help today. At any moment, a scheduled event could get shut down by campus radicals or administrators, and the YAF team must be ready to engage them on a moment’s notice. [**Will you contribute $35 or more today so that YAF’s rapid response team will always be ready to leap into action the next time leftists decide to shut down free speech and deprive students of the chance to hear your conservative ideas?**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zuk5e6go5nrmp984o9rh2477g3m52l8e8dlbu3k0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cjie6o32chh2bs) Friend, a donation of $35 or whatever you choose does more than you know. The impact amplifying conservative voices will have on the future of our country can’t be overstated. I cannot encourage you enough to consider giving to YAF today. Partnering with YAF today is our opportunity to win a generation that values freedom. I can’t think of a better investment. Ronald Reagan stated, “There is no better way to establish hope for the future than to enlighten young minds.” I look forward to hearing back from you. -Ben Ben Shapiro [**Will you support Young America’s Foundation with a contribution of $35, $50, $100, or even $1000 today, to save this generation by presenting conservative ideas to students across the country?**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1onaok58oe41sahvsltrngmoil6icjjags7ukt8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cjie6o32chh2bs) [**DONATE**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z2s7qefuqhu43a9hmv4987q0e01jrin893k5e8s8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cjie6o32chh2bs) [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zksplquo0d3pv9lv0ssi284v0fvibj67vld3ppjg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cjie6o32chh2bs) | | [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zje1vkbrrtk69irr0kajns60aof7t8511hfctpc8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cjie6o32chh2bs) | [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zpd048llntnbqvi0746ceeai4irosgn4ji0pa05g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cjie6o32chh2bs) | [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zjc617gg25i528aa9bcglktn0tdj65i2n3k3qtho_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cjie6o32chh2bs)

Hello,
Growing up in rural Iowa, I thought we were well-to-do because we had a piano, a well-used sewing machine, a big garden, and a flag pole. Our house was small, one bathroom, for a family of ten. I was surprised to know that not every family struggled with affording the $7 meal ticket each kid needed for school.
Lebanon, Iowa, had eight houses, a church, and a small feed store. My life centered on helping my dad, school, and exploring Dry Creek, a wonderland of aquatic life down the hill. The nearest town was Hudson, SD, nine miles west down a gravel road.
We were the prototypical rural Iowa family. Breakfast, lunch, dinner, lunch, then supper kept the house full of aromas. “Read a book,” would be mom’s terse direction if you showed any idleness. It is from this humble beginning, work as a welder, farmhand, then in a slaughterhouse, that brought me into the U.S. Navy.
America must present an opportunity for its citizens to achieve great things. From homemade clothes (I’m the littlest one) to a three-star Admiral is just one such journey. The next step is to use life’s experiences to continue a lifetime of service to this nation and my state of Iowa.
**I’m running for U.S. Senate against Chuck Grassley here in Iowa because I can represent people from all walks of life. My life’s experiences provided an innate understanding for what it means to be a Democrat:_to care as much for those I’ve never met as I do for those I know_. Obviously, Chuck Grassley is not a Democrat; he seems to only care about what Trump and his corporate PAC donors want.**
People like me aren’t supposed to be able to run and win. Mitch McConnell and his Super PACs are already raising millions from corporate special interests to try to make sure I don’t.
If there’s one thing I’ve learned in life, though, it’s that anything is possible when a group of people work together to make it happen. I’m not taking one dime from corporate PACs; instead, I’m running my campaign entirely with support from over 48,000 grassroots donors like you.

| For immediate release April 26th, 2022 I will hold Big Tech accountable
While the purchase of Twitter gives hope to conservatives disgusted by Big Tech's blatant discrimination against them, Jake Evans said today that Congress must do more to safeguard free speech and hold these powerful companies to account for their anti-competitive actions. "As a conservative, I believe in free speech and the free market, but today, Big Tech firms run by leftists control our society's major speech platforms and have used that power to cancel conservatives," Jake said. "We have seen the results of allowing Silicon Valley leftists to determine arbitrarily what is 'hate speech' and 'misinformation,' and what we have is one-sided, ideologically driven censorship. They have turned our American marketplace of ideas into a North Korean grocery store - no choices, limited supply and stale products." Jake said he would prioritize this issue in Congress, where skilled America First attorneys are sorely needed. "I do not believe that 'big' is always 'bad,' but monopolies hurt consumers, censorship hurts America and bias targets conservatives only. When Big Tech decided that American voters couldn't see stories about Hunter Biden's laptop - stories labeled as misinformation that were proven true - they undermined American democracy. Too much is at stake to let this pattern continue, and as a member of Congress, I will hold them accountable."

body:
| Here’s the rundown, team:

**FIRST:** Trump tried to dismantle American democracy by attempting to steal a free and fair election.

**THEN:** He endorsed the most hated Senate candidate, J.D. Vance, who he referred to as the GOP’s best chance at beating the “radical Democrat nominee.”

**NOW:** Trump doubled down on his endorsement of J.D. Vance, even after Vance's recent leaked remarks where he called Trump “Americas Hitler” – but Ohioans are fighting back – and we need your support more than ever in this final stretch. **[Pitch in whatever you can to help us reach our $15,000 end-of-month goal.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44581629/342220317/1375374031?refcode=em22_220426_rally2_fndd_gq_act_eom_ODP_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220426_rally2_fndd_gq_act_eom_ODP_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTI0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYWM5MjA5Ny04ZmM1LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ql0J89Lwfq59tueDQkSVve7eJRkTdenw3vA3Guc5nyk=)**

**But team, it doesn’t stop here.**

Trump has been holding rallies in support of his favorite 2022 congressional candidates to boost their campaigns for a long time to get like-minded, obstructionist candidates elected to office to do his political bidding.**And like all of his rallies, his most recent one in Ohio this weekend included anti-democracy undertones, accompanied by dangerous and incoherent rants about crowd sizes, and the forceful takeover of our voting systems.**
