Peter,

We are 7% behind our average monthly fundraising pace this year.

Here’s why that’s a big problem: Declining fundraising right now makes it
really tough to win our remaining primaries against the Democratic
establishment. And our next two primaries are less than a month away!

We don’t take money from big Wall Street donors or corporate PACs, so it
makes it that much harder to catch up when our fundraising falls behind.

for the people,
Peter.

Our average donation this year is just $17.70. We’re proud of that. It
means we need a lot of small-dollar donations to fuel our primaries.

elect a Congress full of people who will fight for Medicare for All,
canceling student debt, and much more. We’re building up our Justice

clean_body: I’m not running for Governor to break fundraising numbers, I’ve broken plenty of records | | , We are counting down the days until the June 14th primary election. Our campaign has spent the last year crisscrossing South Carolina and it's been a blast- but I'll be honest, it can be exhausting. Our campaign is determined to be on the ground, talking to people about the issues that matter the most in their lives. I've attended almost 100 in-person events, and too many virtual events to count, all while serving in the State Senate. Just like you, I've learned - the juggle is real! I don't say this to complain; I say it because it shows where my priorities lie. I'm not running for Governor to break fundraising numbers, I've broken plenty of records. I'm running for Governor to change the trajectory of our state's future and the people in it. The reality is that it's always tougher for Black women running for office to raise money, but we can't settle for that reality if we want to defeat McMaster in November. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: I am so grateful for the generosity of my supporters, and I know I ask for contributions often. But it's because I truly believe in our campaign and our ability to transform our state. Together, we can build a South Carolina where everyone can thrive. body:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/FAWlogo_Blue%404x.png]
Dear Peter,
I’m thrilled to receive the endorsement of Baltimore City Delegate Dalya Attar! As a Park Heights native who was raised by working-class immigrants, Dalya’s story is a shining example of the American Dream. She’s become one of Maryland’s leading public servants, and has fought to deliver for schools, keep residents safe, and secure higher wages for our workers.
Dalya, I’m humbled to have received your support. I can’t wait to partner with you to secure a stronger future for Baltimore City, double BOOST scholarships for lower-income families, and ensure thriving communities across all of Maryland in the years to come. Baltimore is our largest city and our cultural crown jewel. As Governor, our City will play a central role as we fight to build an economy that works for everyone.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dalyaattarendorsement?amount=20.22 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dalyaattarendorsement?amount=20.22]
This latest endorsement follows a long line of recent major endorsement announcements. I’ve already received more endorsements from current and former elected officials and labor unions than any other candidate for Governor, and we have more announcements to come!
Recent polls show that our people-powered movement is the frontrunner in the Democratic race for Governor. With your help, we can pull ahead even further in the final stretch of this primary. Fresh off the heels of this latest endorsement alert, will you chip in to power our movement to victory? We’re looking to raise $2,350 that will help us print more yard signs and field literature, place more phone calls and knock on doors, and ultimately secure the votes that we need to win this competitive race.
CHIP IN $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dalyaattarendorsement?amount=10]
CHIP IN $20.22 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dalyaattarendorsement?amount=20.22]

CHIP IN $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dalyaattarendorsement?amount=100]
CHIP IN ANOTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dalyaattarendorsement]
My bold vision for the future of Maryland includes combating the student debt crisis, investing in the next generation of internet connectivity, lowering the costs of healthcare and housing, and so much more. Together, we can deliver on these concrete points of progress, and lift our communities into the high quality of life that they deserve.
Our people-powered movement would not be possible without grassroots supporters like you. Any amount you can spare, whether large or small, will make a critical difference in the fight to secure a stronger future for Baltimore City, and for all of Maryland, in the years to come.
Thank you,

[**RSVP here**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44582271/342223793/166173604?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyODNhZDUxMy05M2M1LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RyTjhMrz076iJwfX7Pw19j8Trf1ycRr8x2C1D5-yLx0=&emci=e52b04cb-79c5-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=283ad513-93c5-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=14684837), and join our team and other Baltimore leaders including Senator Cory McCray, Delegate Robbyn Lewis, former Baltimore City Council President Mary Pat Clarke, and more for an exciting and energizing afternoon in the city. ****
* * *
******** Between attending the Afro’s high tea event in Baltimore, connecting with Marylanders for a Sunday brunch, and joining Democrats from Queen Anne’s County for an event on the bay, Shannon had a packed weekend traveling across the state. **** Yesterday, the Starbucks on Charles St. in Baltimore voted unanimously to become the first unionized location in the state. | | | I’m a long-time resident of TX-13. I raised my kids here, invested in my small business here, and plan to retire here. This district is in my blood; it is part of my life and soul.

I promise I will work as hard as I can to meet as many voters face to face as possible. We have a tough road to November 8, but I know that **together** we will persevere.
---
| I believe in:

✅ Protecting Voting Rights
✅ Saying Never Again to January 6
✅ Creating High-Paying Jobs
✅ Expanding access and affordability to education and healthcare
✅ Investing in renewable energy so we can continue to be world leaders
✅ Safeguarding a woman’s right to choose
✅ Rebuilding our rural infrastructure and providing broadband access

And much more!

These may seem like basic rights, but they are ones my opponent – Ronny Jackson – has consistently and vigorously opposed.

**We deserve better** , and we can do it **together.**

Please consider **giving $5** or more now to help restore sanity in our district! Please help me restore sanity to TX-13!

Friend,
I won't sugarcoat it... the news isn't great.

name: American Update
subject: Future generations are counting on your response
body:
Please take time right now to review and complete Hillsdale College’s RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c9971%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=LIP2DdqkgeDCPqhPNhPqfQ&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from American Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c20519%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=CAdvLtu8tsxx2PXoYxx8mQ&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, Can you do me a favor? Please take time right now to review and complete Hillsdale College’s [**RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey**.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c20510%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=bdjAmvih5gKuLPkXxxKv8Q&sysid=1) My name is Bill Gray, and I’m the associate vice president of national donor outreach at Hillsdale College. It’s my responsibility to invite like-minded conservatives (like you!) to support Hillsdale. **I don’t use the word “battle” lightly, but with the stakes so high one must be blunt.** It’s clear to me that we are in a fight for the future of our nation--a fight against progressives who are targeting our youngest citizens. These so-called “progressives” seek to undermine traditional patriotism and ultimately transform American government and society. _The New York Times’_ recent “1619 Project” is the prime example of this effort to inject into the minds of our youngest citizens a biased distortion of our nation’s history. If you haven’t heard, the “1619 Project” places the founding of America in 1619, when the first slave arrived in Jamestown, rather than in 1776 when the Declaration of Independence proclaimed that “all men are created equal” and endowed by God with “unalienable rights.” **“Our democracy’s founding ideals,” the “1619 Project” proclaims, “were false when they were written.”** Outrageous! _The New York Times’_ stated goal with the “1619 Project” is to influence the curricula of K-12 schools nationwide. They teach young people that slavery--not freedom--is and always will be the central and defining idea of the American experience, making our country irredeemable. This project has garnered universal acclaim from the news media. In fact, the lead essayist just won a Pulitzer Prize! There are even talks about making the “1619 Project” into a feature film. **Given popular and widespread efforts like these, we should not be surprised that there is a decreasing sense of patriotism among younger Americans --and an increasing tendency to embrace socialism and other liberty-destroying ideas.** Education has become a battleground, and reviving a proper understanding of American history and government, especially among younger citizens, must be our** _most urgent priority._** Hillsdale College is at the forefront of this effort. **We are actively engaging the Left on the battlefield of education. And I need your help to make this effort even more effective.** Hillsdale is America’s most powerful advocate for intelligent and informed patriotism--our best defense against the loss of our liberty and insidious beliefs like socialism. We do this on our Michigan campus, with an undergraduate and graduate student body of over 1,500, and through education that reaches and teaches millions of citizens each year on behalf of liberty. And in response to new efforts such as the media-driven “1619 Project” that seek to turn the next generation of citizens against the principles of the Declaration of Independence and the U.S. Constitution, Hillsdale must expand this critical work--especially in 2020. As I said before, to fight and win this battle, Hillsdale needs your help right away. The FIRST step I need you to take right now is to complete the **RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY! Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey**. This national project seeks to make it clear that people in your state and nationwide still revere our founding principles of liberty, and refuse to let them be corrupted by those who hold America in contempt. **As _The New York Times’_ efforts make clear, powerful forces vehemently oppose this view of America, and their assault on our glorious history is taking place before our very eyes. ** _Our ongoing response, rooted in genuine learning, and proven to reach millions of citizens, must be escalated as quickly as possible._ And if, upon completing your Battle Plan, you feel a strong connection to Hillsdale’s work, then I urge you to please consider including a generous tax-deductible gift in support of expanding these efforts on behalf of liberty. Based on the costs of Hillsdale’s multiple educational programs--which I will outline fo**r you shortly --it has been determined that to fully implement this [RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c20511%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=WSMcKX4MKOjhZqqyPryk5Q&sysid=1)** for maximum impact, Hillsdale College must raise at least $1,016,700 within the next month. And unlike most colleges and universities that rely on federal funding and subsidies, EVERY PENNY of funding for Hillsdale’s educational outreach comes from the voluntary support of intelligent patriots like you. This is because Hillsdale College refuses EVEN ONE PENNY of state or federal taxpayer funding--even indirectly in the form of student grants or loans. That’s so important, I need to say it again--Hillsdale College refuses EVERY PENNY of government funding! **In this way, Hillsdale remains truly independent, avoiding unconstitutional regulations that would violate the College’s educational mission.** Hillsdale has built national support from hundreds of thousands of citizens. These intelligent patriots know that liberty in America is in trouble thanks to progressive control of our schools and institutions. And these citizens are determined to preserve our liberty--as I believe you are. These supporters give what they can, when they can--gifts of $25 or $50 or more, sometimes much more ... because they understand that every dollar given goes to reaching and teaching millions of people--including our nation’s youth--with genuine learning about liberty and the Constitution. The gift you choose to give today will determine whether Hillsdale can activate each component of the **[RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c20512%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=3jc9EiQDes4SNWA7%2fmg8PQ&sysid=1)** And this entire plan is tied to Hillsdale’s proven programs and publications that are educating millions of Americans right now. Here are the key aspects of Hillsdale’s plan for your review and feedback: **BATTLE PLAN POINT #1: Identify the Critical Concerns of Everyday Americans** I mentioned that our network of supporters that is hundreds of thousands of patriots strong--such a broad base of support gives us invaluable public-opinion data on what Americans are MOST concerned about given the current state of our nation. We are always eager to add new perspectives (like yours) that can make our work the most relevant and timely possible. **Your participation today will allow Hillsdale to strengthen our educational outreach efforts by targeting them where they’re needed most, on the areas of concern that matter most to the American people.** You were selected to be part of this effort based on your record of involvement in causes that strengthen America, AND because of Hillsdale’s confidence that you will respond quickly and honestly, lending your voice to our efforts to restore the Constitution. I’m counting on and very much looking forward to your survey response! **BATTLE PLAN POINT #2: Counter Progressive Teaching in America’s Schools** In this section we dig deep into Hillsdale’s proven educational outreach, and give you a sense of how we lead important conversations surrounding America’s history and founding principles--AND ask what YOU think about these efforts. And make no mistake--Hillsdale is uniquely qualified to drive this effort. Did you know that Hillsdale is one of only a few American colleges and universities that requires each student, regardless of major, to complete a one-semester course on the Constitution? This fact has earned the support of so many Americans who did not attend the College, and who have never even set foot on our campus--they understand that what we teach in our classrooms radiates all over America. Is this important to you? In 2012, Hillsdale began offering online courses _free of charge_ , because we see it as an effective way promote intelligent patriotism and civic virtue. We market the courses on social media and online to reach large audiences, especially younger Americans. The response has been tremendous--over 2.3 million citizens have taken one or more of our online courses. Do you think this is an effective means of reaching and teaching millions of Americans on behalf of liberty? We even have an online course that directly counters _The New York Times’_ “1619 Project.” This free course is called **“The Great American Story: A Land of Hope”** and presents an unbiased and complete account of America’s past. To me this is a great example of why these free courses are needed: They safeguard the country, through education, against the damage to liberty inflicted by the Left. And what do you think about sending a free monthly digest of liberty, to millions of people? This newsletter is called _Imprimis_ , and it features speeches delivered at Hillsdale events by prominent scholars, journalists, and policymakers, focused on political, economic, historic, and cultural topics from a constitutional viewpoint. _Imprimis_ is America’s most widely-circulated publication in support of liberty, reaching more households and businesses than either the _Wall Street Journal_ or the “fake news” _New York Times_. Issues covering topics such as “Rediscovering the Wisdom of American History” and “Shall We Defend our Common History?” set _Imprimis_ apart. The publication is as a powerful counterbalance to the biased media outlets that pursue narrow, ideologically driven distortions of history. (If you’re not yet an _Imprimis_ subscriber, we’ll be happy to sign you up as soon as we hear from you.) **BATTLE PLAN POINT #3: Restore Excellence to K-12 Schools** In this section we explore how Hillsdale College is reshaping American K-12 education, especially through our Barney Charter School Initiative, which helps launch and guide classical K-12 charter schools nationwide, teaching thousands of K-12 students. These schools all have a strong civics curriculum. The curriculum provides young Americans with a solid grounding in our nation’s history, our limited constitutional government, and economics. In doing so, Hillsdale provides communities with a practical model of how schools can best serve students and the country. **Sustained by our supporters, Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative has assisted in the founding of more than 20 classical K-12 charter schools in 11 states, with approximately 12,000 students enrolled. And more of these K-12 schools are opening each year.** Do you support this effort to set a new standard for K-12 education and give young Americans a proper education? Hillsdale also launched a new initiative to send pocket Constitutions to thousands of elementary and junior high schools. We ship them with a promise to send as many pocket Constitutions as their schools need. **The response has been astounding.** We’ve now sent out more than 500,000 pocket Constitutions across the country, and we receive more requests every week. Does this effort to restore the Constitution to K-12 schools sound like a good idea to you? As you select your answers, I believe you will find that Hillsdale’s educational outreach is a powerful way to confront and ultimately overcome the progressive forces that seek to instill in young people the ruinous idea that America stands for slavery, not freedom. I know you love this country, and I hope you will partner with Hillsdale in defending America through education--education aimed at citizens of all ages nationwide. The first step is getting your thoughts on our **[RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c20512%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=3jc9EiQDes4SNWA7%2fmg8PQ&sysid=1)**
With your response you will represent your state as part of a major sampling of citizen opinion that can help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views and concerns of mainstream Americans--views that we can make available to policymakers and opinion leaders when we discuss the Left’s agenda, and use to strengthen our educational outreach efforts. What Hillsdale needs now is YOU--your thoughtful input on the work we’re doing, and your generous support to expand our work. **So please complete the[Battle Plan Survey](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c20513%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=o9RqTKxeAsrhxYtAHI0DFQ&sysid=1) today.** When you give to Hillsdale and share your opinions, you will join a dedicated and growing team of intelligent patriots, who always step up when the time comes to defend America against the progressives’ attack on American history and liberty. Thank you for your commitment to liberty in America. Warm regards,
Bill Gray
Assoc. Vice President of National Donor Outreach
Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 **P.S**. We are in a battle for the future of America, because the Left is determined to transform our country ... by fundamentally changing how history is taught to young people. Education is the battlefield, and Hillsdale College urgently needs you standing with us to support and sustain our efforts. With your help, we can continue to reach and teach millions of citizens of all ages, especially the youngest Americans, with the principles of liberty underlying the Constitution. Please complete **[RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY! Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c20514%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=mIbpI3Hj9hT6WAZXCKgcGw&sysid=1)** to shape Hillsdale College’s defense of America against the progressive assault on history. Your response is needed within five days so we can finalize plans to expand our educational outreach on behalf of liberty.
---
_625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314_
_[Unsubscribe](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/OptOut.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c9971%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=LIP2DdqkgeDCPqhPNhPqfQ&sysid=1)_

Looking beyond partisan politics and abandoning the divisive and vitriolic rhetoric we’re seeing is the key to strengthening our nation.

We Republicans need to stand for genuinely conservative principles and steer away from the dangerous and anti-democratic Trump cult of personality.

Thank you for your support as I fight for a party rooted in substance and guided by our founding values. name: Ron Johnson
subject: This is why I am running.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Republican Party of Wisconsin
body:
Friend -- I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion. We were on an unsustainable path that was mortgaging our children’s future. Fortunately, Americans decided that a government controlled by liberal Democrats wasn’t good for the country, and they elected Republicans to the House to halt President Obama’s extreme policies. A Republican majority in the Senate followed in 2014. As I ran for re-election in 2016, we had the prospect of electing a Republican president who could work with a Republican Congress not only to stop the expansion of liberal policies but, we hoped, to reverse some of the damage done during Mr. Obama’s administration. I figured we had an opportunity to put America back on the right path, and I was more than willing to dedicate myself to that worthy effort. By and large, Republican policies worked. Regulatory relief and a more competitive tax system helped create a healthy economy with low inflation and record low unemployment. Strengthening the military deterred our enemies, and policies designed to secure the borders dramatically reduced the flow of illegal immigration. During the 2016 campaign, I said it would be my last campaign and final term. That was my strong preference, and my wife’s—we both looked forward to a normal private life. However, neither of us anticipated the Democrats’ complete takeover of government and the disastrous policies they have already inflicted on America and the world, to say nothing of those they threaten to enact in the future. Nor did we anticipate the pandemic, the government’s failed response to it, the loss of freedom that has resulted, and the tyrannical approach taken by the elites who have created and maintained a state of fear that allows them to exercise control over Americans’ lives. Instead of everyone working to achieve the goal President Biden stated during his inaugural address—unifying and healing America—it feels as if our nation is being torn apart. As I travel around Wisconsin and talk to citizens who love our country, I know I am not the only one with grave concerns. My message has always been that America is precious, and it is our solemn duty to make sure it survives and thrives for future generations. President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches in 2010: This is a fight for freedom. This is not someone else’s fight, this is our fight, and it’s a fight we absolutely must win. I believe America is in peril. Much as I’d like to ease into a quiet retirement, I don’t feel I should. Countless people have encouraged me to run, saying they rely on me to be their voice, to speak plain and obvious truths other elected leaders shirk from expressing—truths the elite in government, mainstream media, and Big Tech don’t want you to hear. In 2010 I promised I would always tell people the truth and that I would never vote with re-election in mind. When re-election isn’t your primary motivation, those are easy promises to keep. I will continue to fight for freedom in the public realm by running for re-election. It is a decision I haven’t made lightly. Having already experienced a growing level of vitriol and false attacks, I certainly don’t expect better treatment in the future. For my campaign to succeed, I will need the support of every American who values the truth and refuses to allow lies and distortions to prevail. Tens of millions of dollars will be spent trying to destroy and defeat me. The mainstream media and Big Tech will contribute their powerful and corrupt voices as the unofficial but reliable communication apparatus of the Democrats. We face powerful forces that desire even more power and control over our lives. Their path, paved with false hope and greater dependency, always leads to tyranny. We cannot let them win. So I will humbly ask, Friend, for your endorsement to help me SAVE AMERICA. | [](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVf2q8QtklKXcAXi_ICdSDi8Jv1sWF70zZaBSxkirtTsosNsmAkXL95p67NunVpE1A&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=rj_el_4&n=1 "ENDORSE RON JOHNSON") [ENDORSE RON JOHNSON](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVf2q8QtklKXcAXi_ICdSDi8Jv1sWF70zZaBSxkirtTsosNsmAkXL95p67NunVpE1A&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=rj_el_4&n=1)
---
Thank you,
Ron Johnson

| | The Idaho Republican primary is just a few weeks away.

And the momentum is building (i.e. people are fired up).

For instance, I've been endorsed by groups and people focused on individual liberty and freedom, not big business...

**✅ Make Liberty Win
✅ Citizens Alliance of Idaho
✅ Conservative of Idaho
✅ Stop Idaho RINOS
✅ The Gem State Patriot
✅ Rep. Heather Scott**

_... just to name a few. _

My opponent... not so much.

Because he's a statist, not a servant. And although he's a registered Republican... he votes like a California liberal.

For example, JUST LAST MONTH, he voted to spend $11 million on remodeling state lawmakers' offices.

**_Yes, his own office. _**

He's voted to increase spending like crazy (using Biden's ARPA handout money) which led to a budget increase of +16.6% last year, and a +21% increase this year.

He even voted to give money away to teachers for... no reason... just last month (SB1404). Yep, he gave an enthusiastic thumbs up to these "no reason" bonuses using federal debt:
* $23.1 million in $1,000 bonuses for teachers...
* $12.1 million in bonuses for school janitors and cafeteria workers...
* $1.5 million in bonuses for school administrators

That's a total of**$36.7 million in bonuses** , for literally... no reason.

_Again, that's all using federal debt._

It's like borrowing daddy's credit card (Daddy is Joe Biden here) to give your friends money.

Not to mention his votes to expand Medicaid, education, and student indoctrination in the classrooms.

It's absolute madness.

I could go on, but... the choice is clear.

Keep the statist, or, vote for a servant.

You know what to do on May 17th.

Cheers,

Brian

Hello,

Our campaign officially launched one year ago today. And since then, we've
been to all 88 Ohio counties, hearing your stories and asking how I can
best represent you in the Senate.

This wasn’t just some political gimmick. No, visiting all 88 counties is
essential in our effort to build real, meaningful relationships with
Ohioans from all walks of life—hearing from you, answering your questions,
and figuring out where we go from here.

Because while my out-of-touch, millionaire GOP opponents head down to
fundraisers at Mar-A-Lago and fawn over Donald Trump, I’m focused on
meeting with as many hardworking Ohioans as possible and earning their
support one by one, county by county.

Winning this race was never going to be easy. And competing with the GOP’s
money machine has proven to be a bigger challenge than I ever imagined.
But every time I speak with a new voter, I’m reminded of why I’m doing
this in the first place.

I’m running for Senate to represent the backbone of Ohio, reinvest in our
communities and rebuild our middle class. Working families and future
generations of Ohioans deserve a fair shake, and you’re damn right it’s
time we finally cut workers in on the deal.

So yes, our campaign officially visited all 88 counties in Ohio. And yes,
that’s a big deal. But no, we don’t plan on stopping there—so long as we
continue to earn your support along the way.

subject: What happened at Hillbilly Days.

body:
[1]Charles Booker

Last weekend, we made some history,
Peter.

For the first time ever, a Black Kentuckian seeking federal office spoke
at the iconic Hillbilly Days in Pikeville, Kentucky. I am honored.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220426?refcode=em20220426-1819&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&refcode2=1819_346206_Lvl2-b&akid=1819%2E346206%2ELvl2-b ][IMG]

It was so good to be with my family in Appalachia. This moment was proof
that we’re building a movement from the hood to the holler. Together, I
know we have the power to replace Rand Paul this election with a champion
for working families.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220426?refcode=em20220426-1819&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&refcode2=1819_346206_Lvl2-b&akid=1819%2E346206%2ELvl2-b ][IMG]

But first we need to overcome a critical hurdle: winning our upcoming
primary.

The primary election is in 21 days. [ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220426?refcode=em20220426-1819&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&refcode2=1819_346206_Lvl2-b&akid=1819%2E346206%2ELvl2-b ]Will you chip in $21 or anything
you can today to support our people-powered campaign? Every dollar you
give helps us contact more voters from the hood to the holler so we can
grow our movement.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220426?refcode=em20220426-1819&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&refcode2=1819_346206_Lvl2-b&akid=1819%2E346206%2ELvl2-b ]DONATE NOW →

I can feel it in my heart,
Peter. This movement is on the
verge of making history. But there’s still a lot of work ahead of us to
reach out to Kentuckians from all 120 counties and make sure we all raise
up our voices this election to vote Rand Paul out of office.

That’s why we’re driving to different parts of Kentucky and meeting voters
where they’re at. We’re dedicated to having conversations with as many
Kentuckians as we can to talk about the issues that matter most to us and
the crises our communities face. There’s so much we need to talk about
together.

Campaign stops like the one we made this past weekend are a powerful
opportunity to reach people that know our leaders have not been working
for us.

People that believe that we deserve a future where visiting the doctor
doesn’t bankrupt you, where teachers are paid what they’re worth, where
folks don’t risk their lives crossing a failing bridge. People that
believe that if we stand together, we can send a young Black man from the
hood to the United States Senate and replace Rand Paul.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220426?refcode=em20220426-1819&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&refcode2=1819_346206_Lvl2-b&akid=1819%2E346206%2ELvl2-b ]Will you chip in $21 or anything you can so we can meet as many
Kentuckians as possible leading up to our primary election on May 17? This
campaign and all of our travels are funded by grassroots supporters like
you, Peter.

Let’s do this,

Charles

clean_body: We are days away from the first votes being cast. | | | Dear Team, We are days away from the first votes in our election being cast on May 19th. This is the moment when other candidates draw from their network of law school buddies, their parents' country club friends, or even the millions of dollars so many candidates have in their own bank accounts. We don’t have any of that. I have been focused on one thing, and one thing only, since the day in grade school when I witnessed a shooting in front of my house: stopping the bullet and everything that sent it flying in the first place. That’s what this campaign is about, and it is reflected in the values of our donors, our supporters, our movement. Our path is clear. We are running against a machine-backed incumbent who is bought by corporations. The people are ready for change and we have built a true people-powered movement, here in IL-7, with 100's of volunteers, well over 8000 donors, and 175,000 voter contacts. In solidarity, Kina Collins | To give by check: Kina Collins for Congress 901 Lake Street, Unit 4093 Oak Park, IL 60301

Folks,
Thanks to the team for a phenomenal session. My legislative team stayed with me until 10 pm, collating papers, folding them, and stuffing them into thousands of envelopes so we can let our constituents know how we've fought on their behalf in Annapolis.
https://www.facebook.com/VoteJazzLewis/posts/426508395951852?__cft__[0]=AZVkSP0CowyZ-SSCsB7xqmMuz4dJLzb67sm4odNrxPTpySQFAy83Jk48tapdfX3cBnGtChrCTtCyICxwTUaKvJsNH5schSHC8d4KLRPQ8Ty_JNmM0qHI_r0ab2PxhgBD6YETeErftTOBpkgnMdMBoH2l&__tn__=%2CO%2CP-R [https://www.facebook.com/VoteJazzLewis/posts/426508395951852?__cft__[0]=AZVkSP0CowyZ-SSCsB7xqmMuz4dJLzb67sm4odNrxPTpySQFAy83Jk48tapdfX3cBnGtChrCTtCyICxwTUaKvJsNH5schSHC8d4KLRPQ8Ty_JNmM0qHI_r0ab2PxhgBD6YETeErftTOBpkgnMdMBoH2l&__tn__=%2CO%2CP-R]To those who reached out to our office, you should receive one in the mail shortly. To others who want it, let me know and we will get it to you!
Jazz
Scholarship Opportunity
Jazz's scholarship is open to students who are applying to Maryland colleges, universities and apprenticeships programs. You can use the funds at a school outside of Maryland if you get the program or major approved by the Maryland Higher Education Commission! Here's the form to apply. [https://accounts.google.com/signin/v2/identifier?service=wise&passive=1209600&continue=https%3A%2F%2Fdocs.google.com%2Fforms%2Fd%2Fe%2F1FAIpQLSd3XrU0RGBSXOWqP5cEXltFDI7aci6daZB16uqJ4JzuChsoEw%2Fviewform&followup=https%3A%2F%2Fdocs.google.com%2Fforms%2Fd%2Fe%2F1FAIpQLSd3XrU0RGBSXOWqP5cEXltFDI7aci6daZB16uqJ4JzuChsoEw%2Fviewform&ltmpl=forms&flowName=GlifWebSignIn&flowEntry=ServiceLogin]
Veto Overrides
The House of Delegates overrode Governor Hogan's vetoes of critical legislation that will serve Marylanders. We supported the right for workers to collectively bargain, a women's right to reproductive healthcare, investments in Maryland's rail service, and a statewide family and medical leave program.
https://www.facebook.com/VoteJazzLewis/posts/419199486682743?__cft__[0]=AZWGq9So6W4l7JZMoiyRqPDFJm-qTC6ujyWI8Ivn8Ip0wAszH_k7VYFppDB0JDFVXeaNlg3jV56g2nfB7HN35k5bI4LZVD0bhVb8-AYoP21CfflBAfBY2VUOB1ZibMyRIeQPTAgd_9FqxKumzwtufDyh&__tn__=%2CO%2CP-R [https://www.facebook.com/VoteJazzLewis/posts/419199486682743?__cft__[0]=AZWGq9So6W4l7JZMoiyRqPDFJm-qTC6ujyWI8Ivn8Ip0wAszH_k7VYFppDB0JDFVXeaNlg3jV56g2nfB7HN35k5bI4LZVD0bhVb8-AYoP21CfflBAfBY2VUOB1ZibMyRIeQPTAgd_9FqxKumzwtufDyh&__tn__=%2CO%2CP-R]
Governor Hogan has attempted to stand in the way of progress on these important issues, and his actions are reprehensible. These pieces of legislation are critical parts of our work this session, and I’m proud of our efforts to improve Maryland and move our state forward!
Confirmed!
The Senate confirmed Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson to be the newest Supreme Court justice. As the first Black woman ever to serve on the court, she is living history and is an impeccably qualified jurist for our nation.
https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=417942886808403&set=a.301389255130434&__cft__[0]=AZXe09g0-espdDdw8n_ZErPFZDizoHZNgBuBuM4X-k6Jw7iMl-rYDi9e9jot4eYV_wnW-34_aXgxV9b9c7lyWKAViCEAmsR_HxzcUvjNJoEsfHepaVYi0rNcW6Sjzj5w-cq8kapo_1-DSCiUVFLieQ5G&__tn__=%2CO%2CP-R [https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=417942886808403&set=a.301389255130434&__cft__[0]=AZXe09g0-espdDdw8n_ZErPFZDizoHZNgBuBuM4X-k6Jw7iMl-rYDi9e9jot4eYV_wnW-34_aXgxV9b9c7lyWKAViCEAmsR_HxzcUvjNJoEsfHepaVYi0rNcW6Sjzj5w-cq8kapo_1-DSCiUVFLieQ5G&__tn__=%2CO%2CP-R]
Educational Equity
https://www.facebook.com/VoteJazzLewis/posts/414890163780342?__cft__[0]=AZXTpEjYFCM5w6EHVMqugItgHmwRUpgN9meVGiL-x8JP_GCHLwgvypqTfg2byMx_ejcUrdYOPv7aMt4BhRxuUNifEpv2CNuxKbG-EebLrkBLy9clQkDmy15WSrY6EJXhO2lcf9XN76tXnbvaDesERCef&__tn__=%2CO%2CP-R [https://www.facebook.com/VoteJazzLewis/posts/414890163780342?__cft__[0]=AZXTpEjYFCM5w6EHVMqugItgHmwRUpgN9meVGiL-x8JP_GCHLwgvypqTfg2byMx_ejcUrdYOPv7aMt4BhRxuUNifEpv2CNuxKbG-EebLrkBLy9clQkDmy15WSrY6EJXhO2lcf9XN76tXnbvaDesERCef&__tn__=%2CO%2CP-R]Jazz recently joined with a number of the current UMD College Success Scholars. The program is focused on increasing the retention and graduation rate of Black and Latino males and has an over 95% graduation rate! Jazz was in the first cohort back in 2007.

It’s clear: Our movement is sick of corporations calling the shots on Capitol Hill and is ready for bold, transformative change right alongside Pramila.
#
Peter,
Last week, we asked you to let us know what’s on your mind as we prepare for the next few months of this consequential midterm election year.

Dear Peter,

Yesterday, Elon Musk purchased Twitter. He will now take control of a core social media platform that was overrun by the "woke" far-left.

For years, _**conservatives have been silenced, censored, and banned from certain platforms.**_ Meanwhile, they've promoted the far-left's content and allowed them to play by different rules.

Personally, I think this was a broader scheme by far-left billionaires to convince Americans and our youth that socialist, "woke" ideals are commonplace and popular.

Today marks the beginning of the end of that plan. Today, _**FREE SPEECH WON.**_ In a free-market of ideas, I believe that the best ideas will prevail, and the conservative movement will be stronger than ever before.

Just a few weeks ago, I was proud to sign a pledge to phase out the sale of new, gas-powered cars by 2030 here in Washington state -- the most ambitious gas vehicle phase-out goal in the nation.
To meet our emission reduction goals and save our planet, we really have no choice but to divest from Big Oil and their exploitative practices (now on display at every gas station.)

body:

Friend,
When I decided to run for Governor of Maryland, it was about working towards a future of inclusivity, equity, and safety for ALL our communities. We need to invest in ourselves. Which is why my campaign put out a press release this morning, stating our pledge to make a new, redefined ‘State Center’ in Baltimore a reality.
The new State Center will lead to better jobs, stronger communities and less crime. This project can and will serve as a catalyst for the rebirth of this entire area. Instead of a blighted concrete slab that divides communities, this new town center will bring diverse and historic neighborhoods back together through a vibrant center for 21 st century living, dining, entertainment and workplace innovation.
Currently, the 28-acre site in midtown Baltimore is home to several outdated and crumbling state government office buildings. When we talk about making Baltimore safer, this is what we’re talking about. The site is also accessible by Light Rail, Metro and multiple bus lines, and is located in the heart of Baltimore’s Cultural Arts District, situated near the University of Baltimore and the Maryland Institute College of Art (MICA).
Times have changed since Peter Angelos and Peter Franchot helped kill the original State Center 11 years ago. The economy has changed, our city has changed, and even the American workplace has changed. One thing hasn’t changed, though, and that is the need for a process that is fully transparent, fully inclusive and open to everyone who has a stake in the restoration of the City of Baltimore.
At the end of the day, this project will lead to better jobs, stronger communities and less crime. This project has to get done and under the Baker-Navarro Administration, it will get done.
Please consider showing your support in the form of a donation. Together is how we make this happen. [http://secure.ngpvan.com/t_OakHAu1Eyexxm3ZVTwZw2]

name: Fetterman HQ
subject: Republican debate recap
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
They don’t even live in Pennsylvania.
#
Derek, we watched last night’s PA Republican primary debate so you didn’t have to. 😂
Don’t worry, we’ll just give a couple takeaways.
Honestly, one of the biggest moments happened about 2 minutes in... when the moderators’ very first question to frontrunners David McCormick and Dr. Oz was why voters should support them _when they haven’t even lived in Pennsylvania._
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220426-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220426-5547&refcode2=5547_434096_S15nB-&akid=5547%2E434096%2ES15nB-)
_Dr. Oz is from New Jersey. David McCormick is from Connecticut. They are both millionaires._
That’s right — the PA Republican primary is a race between a millionaire from New Jersey + a millionaire from Connecticut. (Or as another candidate on their stage put it, “the two tourists”.) **We can do SO much better.**
**[If you’re with us on that, can you kick in $5 or any amount to our campaign now so we can keep pace with John’s self-funding, carpet-bagging GOP opponents? They’re spending unprecedented amounts to buy their way into PA’s open U.S. Senate seat, and we can’t let that happen.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220426-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220426-5547&refcode2=5547_434096_S15nB-&akid=5547%2E434096%2ES15nB-)**
**[Contribute $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220426-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220426-5547&refcode2=5547_434096_S15nB-&akid=5547%2E434096%2ES15nB-)**
It gets worse. An NBC reporter watched the debate with a group of undecided GOP voters, and Derek, they were not impressed with their choices.
Straight up, they described the debate as “mean,” “disappointing,” and a “three-ring circus.” 🤡
One GOP voter summed it up like this: “I just didn't care for [McCormick and Oz]. **They're just both wealthy guys**.”
Honestly... yeah!
**Every person in this Commonwealth deserves a true Pennsylvania fighter as their U.S. Senator.** Not an out-of-state, out-of-touch multi-millionaire like Oz or McCormick.
No wonder that, together with their super PACs and self-funding, the GOP frontrunners have funneled well over $40 million in TV ads in PA. _They really + truly think they can buy this election instead of winning it with real grassroots support._
**[Let’s prove them wrong. With your support, we can match them dollar-for-dollar, flip PA blue, and send a true Pennsylvania fighter for ALL working people to the Senate. Please chip in $5 today if you can.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220426-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220426-5547&refcode2=5547_434096_S15nB-&akid=5547%2E434096%2ES15nB-)**
“The two tourists” and their millions are a big threat. But they’re no match for our movement. 💪💪💪
Thanks for your support,
— Team Fetterman HQ 💛

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20220426-5547-footer&t=1&refcode2=5547_434096_S15nB-&akid=5547%2E434096%2ES15nB-)**

Hi there, Peter – it's Daniel. You might know me as Abby's husband, but when Abby was in Congress, I was just as proud to be her constituent.
When I first met Abby, one of the things that stood out to me most was her unflinching commitment to her North Star: public service. Hello,
Do you know what “red-boxing” is? I’d never heard of it until today.
Red-boxing is when a political campaign posts detailed instructions on their website (usually inside a red box) of what that candidate wants Super PACs to do for them.
**Well, today my Democratic primary opponent, Abby Finkenauer, posted a “red box” on her campaign website – explicitly asking corporate Super PACs to run TV & radio ads against me here in Iowa and inviting dark money into our Democratic primary process.**
For crying out loud! We are Democrats. We are better than this.
Abby’s “red box” tells Super PACs exactly where she wants the ads against me to run and what she wants them to say... she even wrote an entire TV script and provided the video she wants them to use.
If Abby were to privately ask her Super PAC buddies to run ads against me, it would be illegal. She would be committing a federal crime. But because she’s doing it in “public” on her website, she skirts the law – much like the way Trump did to find dirt on his opponent.
No candidate should be asking corporate Super PACs to get involved in Iowa’s Democratic Senate primary. We need to be focused on taking on Chuck Grassley and the Republicans!
**In order to fight back against Mitch McConnell’s (and hopefully not Abby Finkenauer’s) Super PACs, I’m counting on grassroots donors like you to chip in now. I’m not taking a dime from corporate PACs or Super PACs, so I have nowhere else to turn:**

clean_body: Hello, Do you know what “red-boxing” is? I’d never heard of it until today. Red-boxing is when a political campaign posts detailed instructions on their website (usually inside a red box) of what that candidate wants Super PACs to do for them. Well, today my Democratic primary opponent, Abby Finkenauer, posted a “red box” on her campaign website – explicitly asking corporate Super PACs to run TV & radio ads against me here in Iowa and inviting dark money into our Democratic primary process. For crying out loud! We are Democrats. We are better than this. Abby’s “red box” tells Super PACs exactly where she wants the ads against me to run and what she wants them to say... she even wrote an entire TV script and provided the video she wants them to use. If Abby were to privately ask her Super PAC buddies to run ads against me, it would be illegal. She would be committing a federal crime. But because she’s doing it in “public” on her website, she skirts the law – much like the way Trump did to find dirt on his opponent. No candidate should be asking corporate Super PACs to get involved in Iowa’s Democratic Senate primary. We need to be focused on taking on Chuck Grassley and the Republicans! In order to fight back against Mitch McConnell’s (and hopefully not Abby Finkenauer’s) Super PACs, I’m counting on grassroots donors like you to chip in now. | | Dear Peter, Today is the three week mark. Ballots will be arriving this week to voters across Oregon, and in just three weeks we’ll begin to see the results. That means **in the next three weeks Oregon Democrats will decide whether they want new leadership or to continue doing things the way we’re doing them.** **[I need to reach those voters, Peter, and I need your help. Friend,

I’m a proud Floridian this week – well, I am every week – but this week in particular thanks to the fact that I share a home state with the federal judge who struck down the CDC’s mask mandate.

As a trained lawyer myself, I agree with the Judge that the CDC went far beyond the authority granted them by Congress; this is a good example of the judicial system working for Americans.

In other democracies around the globe with a strong central government, the outcome would have come down to the feelings of the head of government; THANKFULLY, our founding fathers set up the most robust judicial system ever known to man which serves as a much-needed check on the government in Washington.

And speaking of checks and balances, it’s critical that Republicans are successful in our efforts to flip the House this November. Flipping the House in favor of Republicans would send a strong message – hopefully – to President Biden that It’s time to stop courting the progressive left and work from the middle in benefit of the American people.

**If you’re flying this week, I hope you remember the brave judge in Florida who restored your right NOT to mask on public transportation.**

# Bill McSwain: RGGI Will Cripple PA Economy, Rob Thousands of Their Jobs

_Wolf's unilateral decision to enter RGGI means fewer jobs and higher bills for PA families _
**West Chester, Pa.** \-- Bill McSwain, Republican candidate for Governor, responded to [news](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=2f391a5edd&e=b1ec95759b) that Governor Wolf has approved regulations for Pennsylvania to formally participate in the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative (RGGI), fulfilling an Executive Order signed by Wolf in 2019.

This initiative will force two of Pennsylvania's three remaining coal power plants to close, and force many carbon-emitting power plants to pay a hefty fee.

McSwain strongly condemned this effort, explaining that the new regulations will rob thousands of their jobs and cripple Pennsylvania's economy:
---
|
> _**"Instead of spending the last eight years working to lower the gas tax in Pennsylvania and harnessing the resources under our feet to make energy costs cheaper for everyone, Tom Wolf has allowed the radical left to dictate his policy. But Green New Deal nonsense has real world consequences - participation in RGGI will force thousands of Pennsylvanians to lose their jobs and cripple one of our Commonwealth's strongest sectors. It will also force inflation-weary families to grapple with a severe increase in electric and heating bills, and force Pennsylvania further away from energy independence.
>
> It's time to elect a leader who values our Commonwealth's tremendous energy resources. As Governor, I will remove us from RGGI via Executive Order on Day One. I will also harness the full potential of Pennsylvania's energy resources, and turn on the spigot of natural gas. B****y doing so, we will supercharge our economy, help our nation reach energy independence, and restore jobs to hard-working Pennsylvanians across the Commonwealth."**_
---
|
---
| **BACKGROUND: **
Appointed by President Trump, McSwain's record as U.S. Attorney demonstrates his fierce defense of constitutional rights, dedication to upholding law and order, and history of putting criminals and corrupt politicians in jail. Prior to becoming a prosecutor, Bill served as a scout/sniper platoon commander in the U.S. Marine Corps. He was born in Philadelphia and raised in Chester County, where he lives today with his wife, Stephanie, and their four children. More information on McSwain's background and platform is available [here.](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=a8eeb3b2a0&e=b1ec95759b)

body:
Hello!

This past Sunday was the Lincoln-Reagan Dinner of the Guilford County GOP. I intentionally did not attend.

If you did not know, the Guilford County and Caswell County GOP have endorsed one of my opponents in this primary, a violation of the state GOP rules. I was not going to pay for a ticket that would ultimately give assistance to my opponent.

In addition, the campaign's signs are being stolen in the Summerfield area. Interestingly, the same opponent the GOP has endorsed- his signs have not been touched.

How do we win you might ask?

What God has ordained, no effort of man can stop. Daniel, while in the lions den, kept his focus on God, not the lions. Therefore, we maintain our momentum as a grassroots campaign and place our trust in God.

The primary is Tuesday, May 17!!! The prediction is less than 15% of registered voters will actually vote. Show up and vote! Take a friend, tell a friend, and have your friend's do the same. Don't forget, pray for the campaign.

I encourage you to attend the **US Congressional forum** this Saturday, April 30 at 2pm at Mount Pisgah UMC on the corner of Battleground and Pisgah Church (across from the Lowes. A large crowd is expected so doors will open at 1:15. Coffee and light snacks provided.

God bless you and God Bless the United States of America!

**Gerry Austin**

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44585025/342237497/-347403939?refcode2=d94684a1-9cc5-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&refcode=em220426-2-30-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODc1MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOTQ2ODRhMS05Y2M1LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ReUKnI4wwvIyrghbY6LjSCrFPOzgeSsVXsqtu7YX5rY=)

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44585026/342237498/-347403939?refcode2=d94684a1-9cc5-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&refcode=em220426-2-30-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODc1MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOTQ2ODRhMS05Y2M1LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ReUKnI4wwvIyrghbY6LjSCrFPOzgeSsVXsqtu7YX5rY=)

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44585027/342237499/-347403939?refcode2=d94684a1-9cc5-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&refcode=em220426-2-30-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODc1MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOTQ2ODRhMS05Y2M1LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ReUKnI4wwvIyrghbY6LjSCrFPOzgeSsVXsqtu7YX5rY=)

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44585028/342237500/-347403939?refcode2=d94684a1-9cc5-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&refcode=em220426-2-30-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODc1MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOTQ2ODRhMS05Y2M1LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ReUKnI4wwvIyrghbY6LjSCrFPOzgeSsVXsqtu7YX5rY=)

Here’s what Allen Roskoff, President of the Jim Owles Liberal Democratic Club, had to say:
_“Jim Owles Liberal Democratic Club is proud to endorse progressive insurgent Melanie D’Arrigo in NY-03. Melanie’s life experience, advocacy and unwavering commitment to fighting for the people on the margins are why I am confident she will be a relentless partner in the pursuit of LGBTQ equality, criminal justice reform, immigrant rights and universal healthcare.”_

clean_body: | | | | Our coalition keeps growing, Peter Willis. I’m so honored to receive the endorsement of one of New York’s most significant LGBTQ+ advocacy organizations: The Jim Owles Liberal Democratic Club. Named for the legendary gay rights pioneer Jim Owles, this citywide political activist club fights to secure human rights, dignity, and freedom for all people. This endorsement is the clearest sign yet that the people in our community know who I am and what I’m fighting for. For years, I’ve been organizing on the front lines of our district for universal health care, reproductive rights, and economic justice, with the understanding that the fight for LGBTQ+ rights is a critical part of ALL of these issues. At a time when the LGBTQ+ community, especially trans people, are under increased attack, I’m proud to have the most comprehensive of all the candidates in this race to represent NY-03. In Washington, you can be sure that I will fight every day to champion our LGBTQ+ community. Here’s what Allen Roskoff, President of the Jim Owles Liberal Democratic Club, had to say: “Jim Owles Liberal Democratic Club is proud to endorse progressive insurgent Melanie D’Arrigo in NY-03. Melanie’s life experience, advocacy and unwavering commitment to fighting for the people on the margins are why I am confident she will be a relentless partner in the pursuit of LGBTQ equality, criminal justice reform, immigrant rights and universal healthcare.” I’m proud to partner with the Jim Owles Liberal Democratic Club in our fight to protect LGBTQ+ rights and pass universal healthcare for all New Yorkers. Newly released tapes from reporters at the New York Times just exposed the true feelings of House Minority Leader Kevin McCarthy (R-CA) in the immediate wake of the insurrection:
_"I 've had it with this guy [Trump]. What he did is unacceptable. Nobody can defend that, and nobody should defend it."_
You can be sure he wasn't the only Republican who shared that sentiment. Yet days later, when it came time to vote on impeachment, McCarthy and the rest of his caucus changed their tune, voting nearly in lockstep to shield Trump from any accountability for his actions.
**These tapes - the audio of which was first played on the Rachel Maddow Show - are a fitting encapsulation of McCarthy and the GOP's spinelessness when it comes to defending our democracy from the threat of Donald Trump.**
Their shift has been remarkable: In the days after the insurrection, McCarthy suggested that Trump should resign from the presidency for his role in inciting the attack. Today, McCarthy blatantly refuses to cooperate with the House's bipartisan Jan. 6 committee - a committee that has requested McCarthy testify about his phone call with Trump on the day of the attack on our Capitol. It's clear that McCarthy likely has key information that would enable Congress to hold Trump accountable, but he is too focused on courting praise from Trump to do the right thing -- and he apparently doesn't think there will be a political price for his cowardice.
**That 's where you come in. Kevin McCarthy has turned his back on truth, justice, and democracy. That's why I'm calling on 10,000 concerned Americans like you to join me in condemning McCarthy - and all Republicans who refuse to condemn Trump's role in Jan. 6. With our democratic institutions on the line, we all have a duty to raise our voices for accountability.**

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ducey for Governor
body:
Thursday, the Arizona Supreme Court reinstated the 2.5% flat tax signed into law by Gov. Ducey last year | |
---
| | |
---
| | | [ ](https://dougducey.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf4fbf102e325035a83ef3427&id=c62cc8779e&e=55d4e2f84a)
---
| Hello,

Governor Ducey ran on driving down the income tax, and with your help, he won.

Last year he fulfilled a campaign promise by signing into law the largest tax cut in Arizona history: a 2.5% flat tax on personal income. That makes Arizona's the __**lowest flat tax in the nation**__.

Liberal Democrats tried to repeal this historic tax cut, but last week Arizona's state __**Supreme Court reinstated the flat tax**__. This means __**all**__ taxpayers get to keep more of what they earn.

If you're wondering how we got to this point, a few facts about Arizona's economy over the last few years:
* When Governor Ducey took office, he inherited a $1 billion deficit
* Each year, he's passed a responsible, __**balanced budget**__ \-- cutting taxes while adding record funding to public education
* Arizona added half a million people, over __**18,000 new businesses**__ , and nearly 400,000 new jobs
* Now, Arizona's __**unemployment rate is the lowest it's been in 45 years**__

All of this, with the largest income tax cut in state history, record investments in education, and Arizona still has a surplus.

While I'm personally very offended, I'm genuinely sad for the author of this political hit piece. | [](http://links.keepingamericagreatalerts.com/u/click?_t=b17b139d3aa34869835631e0135927b3&_m=532e79f9ecf141f68341c5fbc8b216a1&_e=IIHtm5iIHECAwayubSqJahfOHDD7NRygEJ1lzLDYN0rV6ZfcO_NhT95FEJFJ2dbQnXiu_hrCrdkxbnWKaXHdzT8AwgJy5RwktOPqKtRxuNseMoKjCf1Y0y-wgwoxeEFcinHpn6GvogeUPFrYirq20nTaYFeP-rUq3GUekx7atQk2v085wXuLbjzQzUufULmjhgepusvKpno4BBfSBW5vUUVTq7ojLul7lJN0zB-LOgbHDIMfRFlG_9heHR4FvT--a-4sr8D3OyG8ZhmXfSWEUe2LClwRvKdqTY1GoJ3J-lzs22E5O529m9NLtYrasCmTTl5SbzVAiOokcgI2XklQz76_SgJx89nZvmvySYxw9LCpJmoIz51wg8eL32gvwnLBoLKzw3TZPh-ILN0SNZV7bakGTQTNgQ4bUq294dHSITWvsPmXpRSI9Oc0roKTs_NPRH3PFGKr9S15bpMla2cTRTSkGBVHDvJMhDE0lEbcxVY%3D)

---
Peter,

I have to admit - I hadn't heard of the far-left publication called _The Nation_ before last week. Now, I'll never forget it.

They published an attack piece against me - based on the color of my skin - that is beyond ridiculous and insulting.

While I'm personally very offended, I'm genuinely sad for the author of this political hit piece.

There are a lot of nasty things said about me in this article simply because I'm a Black Republican. Like this:

"Herschel Walker, the football star turned Georgia Senate candidate, is an animated caricature of a Black person drawn by white conservatives."
Or maybe this line:

"Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."
It's shameful.

But the writer doesn't just take aim at me. He questions the support from folks like you, too:

"Most white people in the South vote 'R' like their entire white supremacist project depends on it."
Peter, I never wanted the color of my skin to be a focal point of this Senate campaign. However, can you imagine the reaction from the mainstream media if these things had been said about a Black Democrat? The outrage! There would be calls for the writer to be fired and the publication cancelled.

But I'm not calling for a protest of the author or a boycott of the publication's advertisers. Nothing like that.

_**I think the best answer is to prove them wrong at the ballot box.**_

**[Will you join me in standing up to these racist attacks?](http://links.keepingamericagreatalerts.com/u/click?_t=b17b139d3aa34869835631e0135927b3&_m=532e79f9ecf141f68341c5fbc8b216a1&_e=IIHtm5iIHECAwayubSqJahfOHDD7NRygEJ1lzLDYN0rV6ZfcO_NhT95FEJFJ2dbQnXiu_hrCrdkxbnWKaXHdzT8AwgJy5RwktOPqKtRxuNseMoKjCf1Y0y-wgwoxeEFcinHpn6GvogeUPFrYirq20nTaYFeP-rUq3GUekx7atQk2v085wXuLbjzQzUufULmjhgepusvKpno4BBfSBW5vUUVTq7ojLul7lJN0zB-LOgbHDIMfRFlG_9heHR4FvT--a-4sr8D3OyG8ZhmXfSWEUfHVFoOLHgtC3Z_BOcS0Cuemeu7dtgvZFxK3ka42DOVQdqJGayKlmOgznLV9Hj7ks4rD6gYmEAsT_QqoSCWxf3-aEkFhv0bpCSitq2-GWaT57CvguL8FM8YPK_kj0lWLC7ZHmL8A-iGJfSUEcSzohoYz0AlO0zBI5iDwABDOVJRI8V3k3rVlI9kozhg_Z8mxcjzvWDHY-QLB-Cv1gJy4HZc%3D)**

clean_body: While I’m personally very offended, I’m genuinely sad for the author of this political hit piece. While I'm personally very offended, I'm genuinely sad for the author of this political hit piece. | Peter, I have to admit - I hadn't heard of the far-left publication called The Nation before last week. Now, I'll never forget it. They published an attack piece against me - based on the color of my skin - that is beyond ridiculous and insulting. While I'm personally very offended, I'm genuinely sad for the author of this political hit piece. There are a lot of nasty things said about me in this article simply because I'm a Black Republican. Like this: "Herschel Walker, the football star turned Georgia Senate candidate, is an animated caricature of a Black person drawn by white conservatives." Or maybe this line: "Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people." It's shameful. But the writer doesn't just take aim at me. He questions the support from folks like you, too: "Most white people in the South vote 'R' like their entire white supremacist project depends on it." Peter, I never wanted the color of my skin to be a focal point of this Senate campaign. However, can you imagine the reaction from the mainstream media if these things had been said about a Black Democrat? The outrage! There would be calls for the writer to be fired and the publication cancelled. But I'm not calling for a protest of the author or a boycott of the publication's advertisers. Nothing like that. I think the best answer is to prove them wrong at the ballot box. The media has been against our campaign since we launched last summer, but they have rarely been so brazen to say things as this: "Georgia Republicans want Walker because he's Black and Warnock is Black, and they think they can defeat Warnock in November if they can shave just a little of the Black vote..." I'm not "any old Black person" as the author of the article asserts. I'm Herschel Walker - a proud Georgian and a proud Republican - who has lived the American Dream and wants to secure that dream for the next generation of Americans from all walks of life. The best way to deal with racist tropes like these are to call them out, reject them, and prove them wrong. I hope you'll stand with me against the political hit jobs that the far-left media keep throwing our way. Thank you, Herschel Walker | | PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC. body: Background on revelation that Hunter Biden's business partner met with Joe Biden in the White House. [NEWSLINK] BREAKING NEWS... | | Dear Friends,

I hope this note finds you safe and well. I am pleased to invite you to join my colleague, environmental lawyer and clean energy advocate California Congressman Mike Levin, and I for our weekly Grassroots Volunteer update tomorrow night: Wednesday, April 27, at 5:30 PM Pacific / 8:30 PM Eastern.

Congressman Levin is an accomplished environmental protection attorney and a strong voice for our veterans in the Congress.

Chair of the House Veterans Affairs subcommittee on economic opportunity, Mike Levin has been a driving force behind creating jobs for our veterans and growing our economy. As the grandson of a World War II veteran, he knows firsthand the need to care for our veterans and military families.

We will be discussing the work that we do together in Congress to protect our planet; creating opportunity for everyone, including adding good-paying green jobs, rebuilding our country with resilience; and defending democracy – at home and abroad.

Fellow American,

Have you seen the recent polling which shows us up by ONE point over our Democrat opponent, Senator Raphael Warnock?

**While it's great to be up in the first quarter, the game is a long way from being over. I've never taken anything for granted - and never will. **

Our opponent is flush with cash. **As of March 31st, he had $26 million in the bank.**

He has already been running tv ads for the last two months - _**to the tune of $500,000 PER WEEK**_ - trying to paint himself in the best possible light with voters around the state.

As a practicing pediatrician, I’ve seen how badly our healthcare system needs reform. And I’ve used my unique perspective to pass bills in the state legislature that lower insurance costs and increase access to the quality care that so many families lack.
I was in high school when my mom became a U.S. citizen, and we voted together for the first time in the 2000 presidential elections (for Al Gore, of course). In my first legislative election, I saw voters bring their young children to translate for them at the polls — so as soon as I became the representative for HD-31, I championed legislation to increase voter turnout and access by expanding access to multilingual ballots.
In my practice, I’ve had to tell a 14 year-old that her chronic stomach ache was actually a pregnancy, and as her pediatrician, I was able to give her a choice in that moment — to become a mom, or not. Just last month, I was so proud to stand with my colleagues in the statehouse and vote to pass the Reproductive Health Equity Act, which enshrines the right to reproductive freedom for Coloradans into law.
**But there are only so many things I can do as a pediatrician and state legislator, and these big problems require big solutions on the federal level.** In Congress, I will fight tirelessly to lower healthcare costs, protect choice, and defend our democracy from extremists who would suppress and intimidate their way to power.

clean_body: | = Hey Peter. One of the most important things my parents taught me was to always jump in to help without being asked. When this seat for Colorado’s new 8th District was created, I knew that I had to step up and run. Because Colorado’s families are struggling, and they desperately need someone who will stand up for them in Washington. That is why I got into this race, and it’s what keeps me going every single day. We’re making some big plans for our field operations, but we need your help to lay a strong foundation and make critical investments. = | = As a practicing pediatrician, I’ve seen how badly our healthcare system needs reform. And I’ve used my unique perspective to pass bills in the state legislature that lower insurance costs and increase access to the quality care that so many families lack. I was in high school when my mom became a U.S. citizen, and we voted together for the first time in the 2000 presidential elections (for Al Gore, of course). In my first legislative election, I saw voters bring their young children to translate for them at the polls — so as soon as I became the representative for HD-31, I championed legislation to increase voter turnout and access by expanding access to multilingual ballots. In my practice, I’ve had to tell a 14 year-old that her chronic stomach ache was actually a pregnancy, and as her pediatrician, I was able to give her a choice in that moment — to become a mom, or not. Just last month, I was so proud to stand with my colleagues in the statehouse and vote to pass the Reproductive Health Equity Act, which enshrines the right to reproductive freedom for Coloradans into law. But there are only so many things I can do as a pediatrician and state legislator, and these big problems require big solutions on the federal level. #
Today is a *really* special day for two reasons, Derek. Let me explain why.
**Here’s what I was doing six years ago today. 👇**
[****](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220426-2?refcode=em20220426-5550&refcode2=5550_434096_5xh8mg&akid=5550%2E434096%2E5xh8mg)
_You know it was an important day because I wasn’t wearing shorts._
Yep, that’s me + baby August 😭 voting in the 2016 Democratic U.S. Senate primary.
In case you didn’t know, I first ran for this seat six years ago. We didn’t win, but I’m still so proud of the campaign we ran together.
In a lot of ways, not much has changed since then (including my hair). It was a crowded primary. It was a tough cycle for Democrats.
But other ways, *so* much has changed.
Together over the past 14 months, we have built a historic grassroots Pennsylvania campaign.
Nearly 500,000 individual donations. Contributions from 88% of PA zip codes. Hundreds of volunteers across our great Commonwealth. Polling 30 points ahead of the next candidate. All without ever flip-flopping on our values or accepting corporate PAC money.
**Today also marks three weeks until our primary election,** and I couldn’t be more proud of the movement we’ve created. That gives us just 21 days to meet, reach, and turn out as many PA voters as possible.
**One of the most powerful ways you can support our campaign right now is by making a weekly recurring contribution.**
By committing to a weekly recurring donation — just once a week for the next three weeks — we are able to *accurately* budget for events, organizing, and ads without worrying if we’ll have enough funds.
**[We can’t do it without you, Derek. Can you begin a weekly recurring contribution right now to help us sprint through the finish line and win this primary? Thank you for your constant support and enthusiasm as we enter the last weeks before the primary. Let’s win this, together.
John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania

Every little bit helps, especially when we’re *this close* to the primary.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220426-2?refcode=em20220426-5550&refcode2=5550_434096_5xh8mg&akid=5550%2E434096%2E5xh8mg)**

Derek,

You know when even Fox News has to confront Kevin McCarthy with one of his
own lies, the lie must be pretty blatant. But that’s what happened when
McCarthy went to the border for a photo opp.

During the interview, McCarthy tipped his hand at another plank of the
GOP’s midterm strategy:

Lie. And when you are confronted over it, lie some more. Even when all of
the facts and evidence are against you. Especially then. And especially
when it comes to obscuring Republicans’ own attacks on our democracy.

Fox: “And regarding that audiotape, you had said that New York Times reporting
on it was quote, ‘false and wrong.’ Then the tape came out. Did you lie?”

McCarthy: “No... I never called the President to say to resign. He and I have a
very good relationship.”

And of course, attacking me is also a big part of the strategy. Once
again, McCarthy threatened to remove me from the Intelligence Committee so
Republicans can save face from their humiliating failure to hold Donald
Trump accountable for the attack on our democracy on January 6.

“Adam Schiff... you know, those people won’t be on Intel anymore, and that’s okay.
You can judge me by my enemies, I think I’ll be in good, good, good, good, uh,
judgment.”
